Bring your arm up above your head and hold that elbow with your other hand to stabilise it.
With your back straight, straighten your arm towards the ceiling and lower it slowly behind your head; then change sides.
extension-triceps-polea-tumbado: Place a flat bench with one end towards a low cable fitted with a short bar and lie on your back with your head towards the machine.
Grip the bar with a close grip and your palms facing down, and straighten your arms upwards.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards the machine, without moving them from their position, and straighten them again slowly.
press-banca-agarre-cerrado: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar at shoulder width, narrower than in a normal bench press.
Lower it under control towards your lower chest, with your elbows tucked into your torso.
Press it straight up until your arms are straight.
press-cerrado-multipower: Place a flat bench inside the Smith machine, lie down and grip the bar with your hands at shoulder width or closer, about 15 cm apart.
Unhook it and lower it towards your chest with your elbows tucked into your body.
Stop just before it touches your chest and press until your arms are straight.
press-mancuernas-codos-pegados: Dumbbell bench press with elbows tucked
Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, held parallel to your body.
Lower them towards the middle of your chest, keeping your elbows tucked into your sides.
Press them up until your elbows are straight.
press-banca-agarre-inverso: Lie on a flat bench with your feet on the floor and grip the bar with your palms facing your face, about 40 centimetres apart.
Position the bar over your chest, slightly below your nipples.
Straighten your arms to raise it and lower it slowly to the starting point.
press-jm: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar with a medium grip, with your elbows close to your body and the bar over your breastbone.
Lower the bar towards your breastbone at a normal pace and pause briefly.
Press it back up with control but quickly, in a straight line up and down.
press-tate: Lie on a flat bench and straighten your arms over your chest with a dumbbell in each hand, touching each other, with your palms facing your feet.
Without moving your upper arms or shoulders, bend your elbows outwards and lower the dumbbells to the centre of your chest.
Straighten your elbows to raise them again.
fondos-maquina: Adjust the seat so that the handles are at elbow height and sit with your back supported and your feet on the floor.
Grip the handles with your palms facing each other and your arms close to your body, with your elbows bent.
Push down with equal force through both arms until they are straight, pause and return slowly.
fondos-banco: Bench dip with feet on the floor
Sit on the edge of a bench or a chair, with your hands gripping the edge beside your hips.
Take your weight on your straight arms, lift your glutes off and walk your feet forward a little, with your knees bent.
Lower your body slowly, with your back straight and close to the bench, until your elbows form a right angle, and push back up.
fondos-entre-bancos: Place two benches apart, rest your hands on the edge of one and your heels on the other, with your legs straight.
With your elbows pointing back, bend your arms to lower your body towards the floor.
Do not go below 90 degrees of elbow bend, so as not to strain your shoulders, and push until your arms are almost straight.
fondos-banco-con-rotacion: Sit on a bench with your palms beside your hips, lift your glutes off and take your weight on your arms, with your knees bent.
Lower yourself until your elbows are at about 90 degrees and push back up.
At the top, turn your torso and reach one hand across your body while the other arm supports you; put it back down and alternate sides on each dip.
fondos-suelo: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, your feet together and your hands on the floor behind you, with your fingers pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips and straighten them again.
fondos-paralelas-triceps: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself up until your arms are straight and your body is straight.
With your elbows tucked into your body and your abs tight, lower yourself until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push slowly until your arms are straight again.
fondos-anillas: Grip the rings and lift yourself up into a support position with your arms straight beside your body.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows under control.
Push until your arms are straight again.
fondos-cinta-suspension: Grip the handles of the straps with your hands below your shoulders and rest your feet on the floor, slightly in front of you.
Lower your hips between the handles by bending your elbows.
Straighten your elbows to return to the starting position.
soporte-paralelas: Stand between the parallel bars and rest your hands on them with your knuckles facing out.
Push down until your feet leave the floor.
Hold the position with your arms straight.
soporte-anillas: Get up on the rings into a support position with your arms straight beside your body.
Turn the rings slightly outwards and keep your body in a hollow position, with your abs firm.
Hold the position without bending your elbows.
flexion-diamante: Get face down and bring your hands together on the floor, so that your thumbs and index fingers form a triangle.
Rest on your toes, tighten your abs and keep your back and neck in line.
Lower yourself slowly until you almost touch the floor and push up until your arms are straight.
flexion-codos-pegados: Get into a press-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Lower your chest towards the floor, keeping your elbows tucked into your sides, pointing back.
Push up until your arms are straight without moving your elbows away from your body.
flexion-triceps-rodillas-postura-nino: Kneeling triceps press-up to child’s pose
Start in child’s pose, sitting on your heels with your arms stretched out in front.
Shift your body forward onto your knees and lower into a press-up with your elbows pointing back and your arms tucked into your torso.
Push back up and sit back on your heels, with your abs firm.
extension-triceps-cinta-suspension: Adjust the handles to chest height or slightly lower, grip them with your palms facing down and stand with your back to the anchor point.
Tighten your abs and glutes and lean forward with your arms straight, resting on your toes.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands towards your head and straighten them to return.
extension-triceps-banda: Stand and hold the band with one hand behind your waist and the other behind your neck, so that it is slightly taut.
Without moving your lower hand, straighten your top arm above your head, moving only at the elbow.
estiramiento-triceps: Raise one arm and bend your elbow to bring your hand towards your back.
With your other hand, hold the elbow and gently push it back and down until you feel the stretch in the back of your arm.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds and change arms.
curl-muneca-barra: Sit on a bench and grip a barbell with your palms facing up and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, letting your wrists stick out in front of your knees.
Flex your wrists to raise the bar, pause briefly and lower it slowly.
curl-muneca-mancuernas: Kneel beside a bench and rest your forearms on it, with your palms facing up and a dumbbell in each hand beyond the edge.
Let the dumbbells drop by bending your wrists towards the floor, without loosening your grip.
Flex your wrists to raise them again, without moving your arms or torso.
curl-muneca-polea: Set the cable low and grip the handle with your palm facing up, with your elbow beside your body and your forearm slightly raised.
Flex your wrist to raise the handle, pause briefly if you wish and lower it slowly.
flexion-muneca-banda: Wrist flexion with a resistance band
Rest your forearm on a table or bench with your palm facing down and your wrist beyond the edge.
With your other hand, hold the end of a resistance band above your wrist, with the band passing across your palm.
Lower your hand by flexing your wrist against the resistance of the band and return slowly to the neutral position.
curl-muneca-inverso-barra: Sit on a bench and grip a barbell with your palms facing down and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists in front of your knees.
Raise your knuckles towards your face by extending your wrists, pause and lower slowly.
curl-muneca-inverso-mancuernas: Kneel beside a bench and rest your forearms on it with your palms facing down and a dumbbell in each hand beyond the edge.
Let your wrists bend slowly towards the floor without letting go.
Extend your wrists to raise the dumbbells again, with your arms and torso still.
extension-muneca-banda: Wrist extension with a resistance band
Rest your forearm on a table or bench with your palm facing down and your wrist beyond the edge.
With your other hand, hold the end of a resistance band below your wrist, so that it passes over the back of your hand.
Lift your hand by extending your wrist against the band and return slowly to the neutral position.
flexoextension-muneca-de-pie: Wrist flexion and extension with light dumbbells
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with your elbows bent beside your body and your palms facing down.
Bend your wrists up until you feel a gentle stretch on the inner side and hold while you count to five.
Lower them until you feel the stretch on the outer side of your wrist and count to five again.
pronacion-supinacion-mancuerna: Rest your forearm on a table, or tuck your bent elbow into your side, and hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm slowly until your palm faces up and pause.
Rotate it back until your palm faces down, without moving your elbow.
pronacion-supinacion-banda: Rest your forearm on its side on a table or bench, with your thumb up and your wrist beyond the edge.
With your other hand, hold a resistance band that passes over your hand, at wrist level.
Turn your palm up against the resistance of the band and return slowly to the starting position.
desviacion-radial-cubital-peso: Radial and ulnar deviation with a light weight
Rest your forearm on its side on a table or bench, with your thumb up, your hand beyond the edge and a light weight in it.
Lift your hand, bringing your thumb towards the ceiling, without lifting your forearm off the surface.
Lower it slowly and under control towards the floor and repeat.
desviacion-radial-cubital-banda: Radial and ulnar deviation with a resistance band
Rest your forearm on its side on a table or bench, with your thumb up and your hand beyond the edge.
With the band held above your wrist, tilt your hand towards the floor against its resistance and return.
Then hold the band below and tilt your hand towards the ceiling against the resistance.
paseo-granjero: Pick up a dumbbell in each hand with a firm grip and let your arms hang at your sides, with the weights beside your hips.
With your back straight, walk the distance you have set.
Turn around when you get there and walk back to the starting point without putting the dumbbells down.
paseo-granjero-toalla: Wrap a towel around the handle of each dumbbell to make the grip thicker.
Grip the dumbbells by the towel and let your arms hang at your sides.
Walk with your back straight for the distance or time you have set.
paseo-mancuerna-por-extremo: Walk holding a dumbbell by one end
Grip one or two dumbbells by one of their ends, not by the handle, and let them hang beside your body.
Walk with your back straight for the distance or time you have set, without letting them slip.
pinza-discos: Put two plates of the same weight together and hold them in a pinch grip, with your fingers on one side and your thumb on the other.
Lift them and keep hold of them for the time you have set, with one hand or both.
suspension-barra: Grip the pull-up bar with all your fingers wrapped around it and hang with your arms straight.
Spread your weight evenly between both arms and breathe at a calm pace while you hang.
Before letting go, look at the floor and bend your legs as you land to cushion the drop.
dominada-con-toallas: Loop one or two towels over the pull-up bar and grip them firmly.
Hang with your arms straight and pull your body up by pulling on the towels, as in a pull-up.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight again.
flexiones-yemas-dedos: Get into a high plank with your hands below your shoulders and your fingers spread wide.
Lift your palms gradually until you are resting only on your fingertips and thumbs, spreading the load.
With your body straight from head to heels, lower your chest by bending your elbows and push back up.
estiramiento-flexores-muneca: Stretch out your arm with your elbow straight.
With your other hand, hold your palm and gently bend your wrist back until you feel the stretch on the inner side of your forearm.
Hold for at least 30 seconds without forcing your knuckles.
estiramiento-extensores-muneca: Stretch out your arm with your elbow straight.
With your other hand, press on the back of your hand to bend your wrist down until you feel the stretch.
Hold for a few seconds without forcing your knuckles and release slowly.
estiramiento-oracion: Put your palms together in front of your chest, as in a prayer position.
Without separating your palms, lower your hands gradually until you feel a gentle stretch in your wrists.
Hold for a few seconds and raise your hands again.
crunch-abdominal: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your feet flat on the floor and your hands behind your head, with your neck relaxed.
Tighten your abs and curl your torso up slowly, bringing your ribs towards your pelvis until your upper back lifts off the floor.
Keep your lower back, tailbone and feet on the floor, and lower yourself by uncurling your torso under control.
abdominal-completo: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your feet held under a firm support or by a partner and your hands behind your head.
Raise your torso by curling your back, so that your vertebrae lift off one by one, until your elbows are close to your knees.
Lower yourself by slowly uncurling your back until it rests on the floor again.
crunch-polea: Hold a high cable with your hands beside your temples and kneel with your torso straight, leaning forward.
Lower yourself by curling your back, with your elbows pointing towards your knees.
Once at the bottom, return slowly to the starting position.
crunch-maquina: Sit on the ab machine with your feet firmly placed and grip the handles or cables that your model has.
Curl your torso forward, peeling your back away little by little, one vertebra at a time, as in a crunch.
Return slowly to the starting position without letting the weight drop.
crunch-declinado: Lie on your back on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the rollers and your arms crossed over your chest.
Raise your torso slowly, curling your back and tightening your abs, and pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself under control until your back is resting on the bench again, without moving your head.
crunch-fitball: Sit on the exercise ball with your feet firmly on the floor and slide down until your lower back is resting on the centre of the ball.
With your hands crossed over your chest or beside your ears, lift your head, shoulders and chest by tightening your abs.
Pause briefly and return slowly to the starting position.
crunch-bicicleta: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Bring one knee towards your chest while twisting your torso to bring the opposite elbow towards it, and straighten the other leg at the same time.
Change sides with a controlled pedalling movement, keeping your abs engaged throughout the exercise.
crunch-inverso: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides and your palms on the floor, and raise your legs until your knees are over your hips, bent at a right angle.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips off the floor, curling your spine to bring your pelvis towards your ribs, without changing the angle of your knees.
Lower your spine slowly to the floor and control your legs so that your knees come back over your hips without going past them.
elevacion-piernas-banco: Lie on your back on a bench with your legs off the end from the knees down, and hold on to the bench or put your hands under your hips.
With your legs together and almost straight, raise them until they are nearly vertical above your hips.
Pause and lower them slowly until they are almost horizontal, without resting them on the bench.
elevacion-rodillas-colgado: Hang from the pull-up bar with your arms straight and your feet off the floor.
With your knees bent, raise your legs under control until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly and lower your legs slowly, without swinging your body.
elevacion-piernas-colgado: Hang from the bar with a firm grip in both hands and your arms straight.
Raise your straight legs until they form a right angle with your torso.
Pause and lower them under control, without using momentum or swinging.
elevacion-piernas-silla-romana: Rest your forearms on the pads of the Roman chair and let your body hang with your legs loose.
Raise your legs as high as you can, pause briefly at the top and lower them again.
Keep your torso still throughout the exercise so that only your legs move.
pies-a-la-barra: Hang from the pull-up bar with your arms straight.
Raise your legs by tightening your abs until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs under control to the starting position.
patadas-alternas: Lie on your back and lift your straight legs off the floor.
Lower one leg until it almost touches the floor while raising the other, and alternate in a continuous movement.
Keep your legs straight and your abs tight throughout the exercise.
posicion-hueca: Lie on your back on the floor or on a mat, with your arms and legs straight.
Tighten your abs and lift your head, shoulders, arms and straight legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold the position with your lower back pressed into the floor the whole time.
bicho-muerto: Lie on your back with your arms pointing at the ceiling and your knees over your hips, bent at a right angle.
Draw your belly button towards your spine and keep your lower back in contact with the floor throughout the exercise.
Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg until they almost touch the floor, without resting them, and return to the centre.
Repeat on the other side, breathing continuously.
toques-talon-tumbado: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides and your legs in the air, with your knees bent at a right angle.
Slowly lower one foot until your heel touches the floor, keeping your lower back pressed into the floor.
Return to the starting position and alternate legs.
retraccion-abdominal: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
At the end of a breath out, gently draw your belly button towards your spine, without moving your hips or ribs.
Hold that contraction while you keep breathing normally, without holding your breath.
plancha-antebrazos: Lie face down with your elbows below your shoulders and your forearms on the floor, palms facing down.
Tighten your abs and thighs and lift your body onto your forearms and toes, forming a straight line.
Hold the position, breathing normally, without letting your lower back sag or your hips rise, and lower yourself gently.
plancha-alta: Lie face down with your palms on the floor beside your shoulders and straighten your arms until you are resting only on your hands and toes.
Keep your back, arms and legs straight the whole time, without letting your hips sag or rise.
plancha-toque-hombro: Get into a high plank with your hands below your shoulders and your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift one hand and touch the opposite shoulder with it, holding the plank position.
Put your hand back down and repeat with the other, alternating.
plancha-arriba-abajo: Get into a high plank with your palms below your shoulders and your body in a straight line, squeezing your thighs and glutes.
Lower one elbow first and then the other until you are resting on your forearms.
Place one hand and then the other to return to the high plank, keeping your body straight throughout.
rueda-abdominal: Kneel on the floor and firmly grip the handles of the wheel, placed in front of your knees.
With your abs tight, roll the wheel forward slowly, stretching your body out.
Pull the wheel back towards your knees to return, without losing the tension in your abs.
rollout-barra-rodillas: Place a loaded barbell on the floor and kneel behind it, gripping it overhand at shoulder width.
With your arms straight, roll the bar forward slowly until your back is straight.
Roll back until the bar is below your shoulders, without bending your arms.
rollout-barra-de-pie: Stand with a loaded barbell on the floor by your feet, bend at the waist and grip it overhand at shoulder width.
With your arms straight, roll the bar forward slowly until your back is straight.
Roll back towards your feet while raising your hips to the starting position.
encogimiento-rodillas-fitball: Lie face down on the exercise ball and walk your hands forward until your thighs or knees are on top of it, with your hands below your shoulders.
With your body straight and your abs firm, bring your knees towards your chest, rolling the ball until your shins are on it.
Straighten your legs again to the starting position without letting your lower back sag.
pica-fitball: From lying face down on the exercise ball, walk your hands forward until only your toes are on the ball, with your arms straight.
With your legs straight, raise your hips until they are over your shoulders while the ball rolls towards your hands.
Lower slowly until you are back in the starting straight line.
gateo-oso: Support yourself on your hands and toes, with your hands shoulder-width apart and your back straight.
Move forward by moving one hand and the opposite leg at the same time, then the other two.
Keep your hips and shoulders at the same height throughout.
l-sit-pies-apoyados: Sit on the floor with your legs together and straight and your hands on the floor beside your hips.
Push the floor away with your arms straight until your hips lift, leaving your feet on the floor to take off some of the weight of your legs.
Hold the position for as long as you need.
l-sit-encogido: Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, with your arms straight and locked.
Lift your body off the floor and bring your knees towards your chest, with your feet in the air and your back upright.
Hold the position with your shoulders down and your abs firm.
l-sit: Sit on the floor with your legs together and straight and your hands on the floor at the sides of your hips.
Push with your arms straight until your hips and feet lift off the floor, with your legs straight in an L shape.
Hold the position as long as you can without your feet touching the floor.
plancha-lateral: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your forearm on the floor below your shoulder.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips until you are resting only on your forearm and the side of your feet, with your body straight.
Hold the position, lower under control and repeat on the other side.
plancha-lateral-rodillas: Lie on your side with your knees bent, one leg on top of the other, and prop yourself up on your forearm with your elbow below your shoulder.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips off the floor, keeping your bottom knee on the floor and your head in line with your spine.
Lower slowly to the starting position, then repeat on the other side.
plancha-lateral-dinamica: Get into a side plank on your elbow and the side of your foot, with your body in a straight line.
Lower your hips towards the floor and raise them back to the straight line.
Repeat the movement under control, then change sides.
plancha-alta-rotacion: Get into a high plank with your hands below your shoulders, your feet hip-width apart and your glutes squeezed.
Push the floor away with one hand and rotate your hips and shoulders to bring your other arm towards the ceiling.
Lower your arm, put your hand down and rotate to the other side, alternating.
toques-talon-laterales: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your feet flat on the floor and your arms straight beside your body, without touching the floor.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly and, without lowering them, bend your torso to one side to bring your hand towards that heel.
Return to the centre and repeat towards the other side, alternating.
press-pallof-polea: Stand side-on to the cable and hold the handle with both hands next to your breastbone.
With your torso facing forward, slowly straighten your arms in front of you without letting the cable rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest under control, then repeat facing the other way.
press-pallof-banda-rodillas: Fix a resistance band to a sturdy point and kneel side-on to it, with your torso upright and your hands next to your breastbone.
Straighten your arms in front of you without letting the band rotate your torso.
Bring your hands back to your chest under control and repeat facing the other way.
lenador-polea: Set the cable slightly below chest height and stand side-on, with your hips stable and facing forward.
Grip the handle with your arms straight and bring it forward across the front of your body.
Hold for an instant at the end of the movement and return slowly to the starting position.
lenador-inverso-banda: Tie a resistance band to a sturdy point below knee height and grip it with both hands, as if it were a bat.
With your knees bent, start with your hands beside one hip.
Rotate your hips and torso while bringing your hands diagonally up above the opposite shoulder, and return under control.
rotacion-tronco-balon-sentado: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, your heels on the floor and a light medicine ball next to your abdomen.
With your chest high and your abs firm, slowly rotate your torso and the ball to one side, without leaning back.
Pause briefly and rotate to the other side, keeping the ball close to your body.
giro-ruso: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean your torso back with your back straight.
Lift your feet off the floor and rotate your torso to one side until your hands lightly touch the floor.
Rotate to the other side and alternate, keeping your feet in the air.
rotacion-landmine: Hold the free end of a barbell anchored to the floor with both hands and push it up until your arms are extended upwards.
Rotate your torso to lower the bar in an arc towards one side of your hips.
Bring it back up under control to the starting position.
flexion-lateral-mancuerna: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your torso to one side as far as you can, bending only at the waist, without moving your hips or knees.
Come back up slowly until you are upright and, when you finish, change the dumbbell to the other hand.
crunch-lateral-de-pie: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Bend your torso to one side, bringing your elbow towards the hip on that side.
Return to the upright position and repeat towards the other side.
paseo-maleta: Hold a dumbbell firmly in one hand only, with your arm straight beside your body.
Walk forward and back with your torso upright, without leaning to either side to compensate for the weight.
Change the dumbbell to the other hand and repeat the walk.
limpiaparabrisas-colgado: Hang from the pull-up bar and raise your straight legs towards the ceiling.
With your legs straight, move them to one side and then to the other, like a windscreen wiper.
When you finish, lower your legs under control.
perro-pajaro: Get on all fours with your hands below your shoulders and your knees below your hips, with your back neutral.
Tighten your abs and stretch one leg back and the opposite arm forward, as far as you can while keeping your lower back stable.
Keep your hips and shoulders level, without rotating, and return slowly to repeat on the other side.
superman: Lie face down with your legs straight and your arms stretched out in front of your head.
Tighten your abs and lift your arms and legs a few centimetres off the floor at the same time, without rotating them or lifting your head.
Hold for a moment at the top and lower slowly to the starting position.
hiperextension-lumbar: Back extension on a hyperextension bench
Position yourself on the hyperextension bench with your ankles under the rollers and your thighs resting on the pad.
With your arms crossed over your chest and your back straight, lower your torso towards the floor by bending at the hips.
Come up slowly until your torso is in line with your legs, without going past horizontal.
extension-lumbar-fitball: Lie face down on the exercise ball with your toes firmly on the floor.
With your hands crossed over your chest or beside your ears, lift your chest away from the ball.
Lower slowly until your chest rests on the exercise ball again.
estiramiento-cobra: Lie face down with your legs straight and your hands on the floor below your shoulders.
Press your hips into the floor and lift your chest by straightening your arms; if your hips lift, bend your elbows slightly.
Hold for 15 to 30 seconds and lower slowly.
postura-del-nino: Kneel with your big toes together and your knees apart, and place your hands on the floor below your shoulders.
Take your glutes back towards your heels without moving your hands, until your chest is between your thighs and your forehead is on the floor.
Hold the position for 30 seconds to a minute, breathing slowly.
gato-vaca: Get on all fours with your hands below your shoulders, your knees below your hips and your back neutral.
As you breathe out, draw your abdomen in and round your back up towards the ceiling, letting your head drop; hold for 10 to 15 seconds.
Then let your abdomen drop towards the floor to curve your lower back and bring your shoulder blades together; hold for another 10 to 15 seconds.
rotacion-rodillas-tumbado: Lie on your back with your knees bent and together.
Slowly let both knees drop to one side while keeping your upper body still on the floor.
Hold for at least 30 seconds and repeat towards the other side.
rodillas-al-pecho: Lie on your back and bring your knees towards your chest, using your arms to help.
To intensify it, lift your head and bring your chin towards your chest; if you find it hard, do it with one leg at a time.
hip-thrust-barra: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Place the bar across your upper thighs, close to your hips, with a pad for comfort.
With your feet directly below your knees, drive your hips up until you form a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your tailbone towards the floor under control and repeat.
hip-thrust-mancuernas: Rest your upper back and shoulders across a flat bench, with your feet on the floor hip-width apart.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand resting on your hips.
Slowly lower your tailbone towards the floor without letting go of the dumbbells.
To come up, push the floor away with your feet and squeeze your glutes.
hip-thrust-banco: Bodyweight hip thrust on a bench
Rest your upper back on a bench, with your feet on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Put your hands on your hips or cross them over your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and raise your hips until they are level with your knees and shoulders; then lower.
hip-thrust-una-pierna: Rest your upper back on a bench, with your feet on the floor and your knees bent.
Lift one leg off the floor.
Push through the planted foot and extend your hips until your knee, hip and shoulders are in line; lower and, when you finish, change legs.
hip-thrust-maquina: Lie back on the backrest of the machine and fasten the belt at hip level.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, turned slightly out.
Push your hips up against the belt and lower them under control.
puente-gluteos: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and abs and lift your hips off the floor until you form a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Without arching your lower back, lower slowly to the starting position.
puente-gluteos-una-pierna: Lie on your back with your knees bent, lift one leg and hold your thigh to bring that knee towards your chest.
Brace your abs and, pressing the heel of your planted foot into the floor, raise your hips by squeezing your glute.
Do not go so high that your lower back arches; lower slowly and, when you finish, change legs.
puente-gluteos-fitball: Glute bridge with feet on an exercise ball
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet resting on top of an exercise ball.
Without moving the ball, push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips off the floor.
With your shoulders and upper back on the floor, form a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your hips slowly without letting the ball move.
puente-gluteos-banda: Place a mini band around your calves and lie on your back with your knees bent.
Raise your hips into a bridge, keeping the band taut.
Lower until your hips lightly touch the floor and come back up, with your spine straight and moving mainly from your hips.
puente-gluteos-extension-pierna: Glute bridge with alternating leg extension
Lie on your back with your knees bent and raise your hips into a bridge, with your weight on your heels.
Without lowering your hips, shift your weight onto one leg and straighten the other; then alternate.
Keep your hips as extended as possible throughout the exercise.
patada-gluteo-cuadrupedia: Get on all fours, with your hands and knees on the floor.
Push one foot back until your leg is fully straight, focusing on your glute.
Hold for a second, return to the starting position and alternate legs.
patada-gluteo-banda: Get on all fours with a resistance band attached to the working foot.
With your abs firm and your back flat, drive your heel back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top and return slowly to the starting position.
extension-cadera-de-pie: Stand and rest your hands on a wall, a post or the back of a chair for balance.
With your torso upright, raise one straight leg behind you without arching your back; you should feel it in your glute and the back of your thigh.
Hold at the top for up to 5 seconds, lower slowly and repeat with the other leg.
patada-gluteo-polea: Set the cable at the lowest position and fasten the ankle strap around one ankle.
Facing the machine, hold on to it, bend your knees slightly and brace your abs.
With your torso upright, drive your leg back and up with your glute, as high as you can.
Return slowly and, when you finish, change legs.
pull-through-polea: Attach a rope to the lowest cable, stand with your back to the machine with the rope between your legs and take a few steps forward to make it taut.
With your back flat and your knees slightly bent, push your hips back as if closing a door with them.
When you feel tension at the back of your thighs, stand up again by driving your hips forward.
swing-kettlebell: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent, holding the kettlebell with both hands.
With your back straight, push your hips back and let the kettlebell pass between your legs.
Push your chest out and drive your hips forward quickly so that the kettlebell rises to chest height; the power comes from your legs and hips, not your shoulders.
Guide it back between your legs and go straight into the next rep.
peso-muerto-sumo: With the loaded bar on the floor, step up until it is over the middle of your feet and set your feet very wide, close to the plates.
Bend at the hips to grip the bar with your arms inside your legs, directly below your shoulders.
Relax your shoulders, take a breath and lift the bar by straightening your hips and knees until you are standing.
peso-muerto-sumo-kettlebell: Set your feet wider than your shoulders, with your toes turned out, and hold the kettlebell.
With your back straight, your shoulders back and your chest high, lower yourself by bending your knees and hips, with your knees following the direction of your toes.
Rise until you are standing, squeezing your glutes.
zancada-frontal: Stand with your feet together, brace your abs and draw your shoulder blades down and back without arching your lower back.
Step forward, landing heel first, and shift your weight onto your front foot.
Let your hips drop towards the floor until your front thigh is roughly parallel to it, with your back flat.
Push hard through your front leg to return to the starting position.
zancada-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your feet about 20 centimetres apart and your toes pointing forward.
Take a long step forward with your abs firm and your torso straight.
Lower yourself until your back knee is just above the floor and your front knee is at a right angle; hold for a moment and return.
zancada-barra: Rest the bar across your upper back with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Take a long step forward with your torso straight and your abs firm.
Lower yourself until your back knee is just above the floor, without touching it, hold for a moment and return; repeat with the other leg.
zancada-caminando: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, take a long step forward and lower yourself until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Pause and, without moving your front leg, bring your back leg forward, placing your heel and then your toes down.
Lower into the next lunge and keep alternating legs without stopping.
zancada-caminando-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a long step so that your front knee forms roughly a right angle, with your back knee close to the floor without touching it.
Complete the step by standing up and continue with the other leg.
zancada-atras: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands at your sides.
Step back onto the ball of your foot and bend your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Pause and push through your back foot to return, with your torso straight; alternate legs.
zancada-atras-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your feet about 20 centimetres apart and your toes pointing forward.
Step back slowly with one leg.
With your abs firm and your torso straight, lower yourself until your back knee almost touches the floor, hold for a moment and return.
zancada-atras-barra: Lift the bar off a rack at chest height and rest it on your shoulders, with your hands slightly wider than them.
With your feet about 20 centimetres apart and your toes pointing forward, step back slowly.
With your torso straight, lower yourself until your back knee almost touches the floor, hold for a moment and return to the starting position.
zancada-atras-salto: With your feet hip-width apart, take your right leg back and touch the floor with the ball of your foot, bringing your right arm forward.
Drive up into a jump, raising your right knee in front of you and stretching your left arm above your head.
To make it harder, lower into a full lunge; finish one side before changing.
zancada-estatica: Stand with one foot forward and the other back, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Lower yourself slowly by bending both knees until your front leg forms almost a right angle, without your knee going past your toes.
Push up through your front leg, with your back straight; finish your reps before changing legs.
zancada-salto: Stand with one leg in front and the other behind, with your torso leaning slightly forward from the hips and your abs firm.
Drop quickly and jump by pushing the floor away with both feet, straightening your ankles, knees and hips.
In the air, switch legs and move your arms opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your midfoot, sending your hips back and down to absorb the landing, without locking your knees.
zancada-lateral: Stand with your feet parallel and hip-width apart, brace your abs and put your weight on your heels.
Step to the right with both feet pointing forward and, once your foot is down, push your hips back, shifting your weight onto your right foot.
Lower yourself until your right shin is vertical and your knee is over your second toe, with your left leg almost straight and your heels on the floor.
Push through your right leg to return and repeat to the other side.
zancada-lateral-mancuernas: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Step to the right with your foot pointing forward, parallel to the other.
Push your right hip back and lower your hands to either side of your right leg.
Push the floor away with your right foot and return to the centre, using the inside of your left leg to help.
zancada-cruzada: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Cross one leg behind the other and lower yourself, with your front knee aligned over your heel.
Push back to the wide position and alternate legs.
sentadilla-bulgara: Standing in front of a bench or a chair, take a long step forward and rest the top of your back foot on the seat.
With your front foot far enough forward to give you a wide base, bend that knee and lower your back knee towards the floor.
Balance yourself with your arms and come back up before your back knee touches the floor.
sentadilla-bulgara-mancuerna: Stand with your right foot in front and the top of your left foot resting behind you on a bench or box at knee height.
Hold a dumbbell upright in front of your chest with both hands and your elbows tucked into your ribs.
With your back straight, lower your left knee towards the floor.
Before it touches the floor, push through your right foot and press the top of your left foot into the bench to come up.
sentadilla-bulgara-barra: Place a bench or box 30 to 45 centimetres high behind you and rest the bar on your shoulders.
Put one foot on the bench and the other firmly on the floor, 60 to 90 centimetres in front.
With your abs firm, lower yourself slowly by bending your front knee and hip as far as you can control.
Pause, come up slowly and change legs.
subida-lateral-escalon: Stand side-on next to a box or step, with one foot on top and the other on the floor, slightly behind.
With your arms bent at 90 degrees, step up by pushing through your top leg.
Let the glute of that leg do almost all the work, without pushing off with the leg on the floor.
salto-lateral-un-pie: Stand upright with your feet together.
Jump to the right while swinging your arms forward and land on your right foot.
Bring your left foot next to your right and repeat the jump.
abduccion-cadera-maquina: Sit with your back against the backrest and adjust the seat so that your knees are aligned with the pivot of the machine.
Rest the outside of your thighs against the pads and grip the handles or the sides of the seat.
Push your legs apart slowly against the resistance and return under control to the starting position.
aduccion-cadera-maquina: Sit on the machine with your knees on the inside, against the pads, and grip the side handles.
Brace your abs and bring your thighs together against the resistance.
Return slowly to the starting position.
aduccion-cadera-polea: Set the cable at the lowest position and fasten the ankle strap just above your right ankle.
Move three or four steps to the left, with your right side towards the machine, your back straight and your left knee slightly bent.
Bring your right foot towards the centre until it is in front of your left and pause for a second.
Let your leg return slowly to the side, without leaning or twisting your torso.
abduccion-tumbado-lado: Lie on your side with your legs straight and together, your head on your lower arm and your top hand on your hip.
With your hips and shoulders stacked vertically, slowly raise your top leg with your knee straight and pointing forward.
Stop before your hips tilt or you feel tension in your lower back, without going past about 45 degrees.
Lower slowly and, when you finish, change sides.
aduccion-tumbado-lado: Lie on your side with your legs straight, your head on your lower arm and your top hand on your hip.
Bring your bottom leg forward until it is in front of your top leg, with both feet on the floor.
Slowly lift your bottom leg with your knee straight, without letting your hips tilt or your knee rotate, and lower it under control; then change sides.
almeja: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your feet together.
Squeeze your glutes and open your top knee as far as you can without your pelvis rolling forward or back.
Keep your back straight, lower slowly and change sides when you finish.
almeja-banda: Place a resistance band just above your knees and lie on your side with your legs bent, one on top of the other.
With the inner edges of your feet together, rotate your top leg outwards to the end of its range.
Lower it under control and change sides when you finish.
almeja-plancha-lateral: Lie on your side with your elbow below your shoulder, your hips stacked and your knees bent, with the bottom one on the floor.
Rise into a side plank, supported on your bottom knee, and open your top knee at the same time.
Lower slowly, closing your top knee, until your hip lightly touches the floor and change sides when you finish.
elevacion-lateral-pierna-pie: Stand and rest your hands on the back of a chair, a wall or another sturdy support.
Raise one leg out to the side as far as is comfortable, with your back and hips straight and without leaning your body.
Return to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
paso-lateral-banda: Place a band around your ankles or above your knees and get into a half squat, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Staying in the half squat, take a wide step to one side, keeping the band taut.
Bring the other foot in, without dragging it, until your feet are shoulder-width apart again, with your torso upright and your toes pointing forward.
paso-monstruo-banda: Place the band around your ankles, your shins or near your knees and get into a quarter squat.
Without coming up, move forward with diagonal steps.
Walk backwards to the starting point; to make it harder, move the band lower or use a stronger one.
abduccion-sentado-banda: Place a mini band around your calves and sit on the floor with your knees bent, your feet flat and your hands slightly behind you.
With your back straight, open your legs out to the sides by rotating your hips outwards.
Return under control to the starting position.
patada-lateral-cuadrupedia: Get on all fours with your hands below your shoulders and your knees below your hips, your back long and your abs firm.
Lift one leg out to the side, with your knee bent, until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor.
Straighten and bend your knee and bring it back under your hip.
rana-boca-abajo: Lie face down with your knees bent at 90 degrees, about 30 centimetres apart, with your heels together.
With your head down, squeeze your glutes and raise your feet towards the ceiling until your thighs lift off the floor.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.
empuje-isometrico-pared: Stand side-on next to a wall.
Bend the hip and knee of the leg closest to the wall to 90 degrees.
Push the floor away with your standing foot while pressing your bent leg into the wall, without moving.
copenhague: Lie on your side with your elbow directly below your shoulder, as in a side plank.
Rest the inside of the foot or ankle of your top leg on a bench.
Raise your hips and keep your body in a straight line, without your bottom leg touching the floor.
copenhague-rodilla: Lie on your side on your forearm and rest the inside of your top knee on a low bench.
Press your top leg into the bench, lift your hips off the floor and hold the position.
To progress, also lift your bottom leg until your knees meet.
estiramiento-gluteo-tumbado: Lie on your back and bring both knees towards your chest.
Cross one leg over the opposite thigh.
Hold the back of the lower thigh with both hands and bring it towards your chest; hold for 15 to 20 seconds and change sides.
estiramiento-mariposa: Sit with your back straight and your knees bent.
Put the soles of your feet together and hold them with your hands.
Gently lower your knees towards the floor and hold for 15 to 20 seconds.
estiramiento-rana: Get on all fours, spread your knees out to the sides and rest on your elbows.
Without moving your elbows or knees, rock back and forth, trying to bring your glutes towards your feet.
sentadilla-peso-corporal: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your hips, your toes turned slightly out and your arms at your sides.
Brace your abs and push your hips back and down, bending your hips and knees at the same time, with your back flat.
Lower yourself until your thighs are almost parallel to the floor or until your heels start to lift.
Push up through your heels, with your knees in line with your second toe.
media-sentadilla-apoyo: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and rest your hands on the back of a sturdy chair or a bench.
Slowly bend your knees only as far as is comfortable, no further than about 45 degrees, with your knees towards your big toe and your back straight.
Come back up gently, squeezing your glutes.
sentadilla-asistida-cinta: Standing and facing the anchor point, hold the handles of the suspension trainer and lean back until your arms are straight.
Squat down, letting the handles support part of your weight, which allows you to go lower.
Push up with your legs and use your arms only to help.
sentadilla-prisionero: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your toes pointing forward, and put your hands behind your head with your elbows out to the sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, keeping your torso as upright as possible.
Push your knees outwards, never letting them come together, and come back up.
sentadilla-con-banda: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the ends or the handles and bring them up to your shoulders.
With your abs firm, squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor and come back up slowly with your feet firmly planted.
sentadilla-con-disco: Squat with a plate held in front
Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, holding a weight plate in front of your body with your arms straight.
With your abs firm and the natural curve in your back, push your hips back and squat down as far as you can.
Hold for a few moments at the bottom and come back up.
sentadilla-hindu: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms slightly behind your body.
As you go down, lift your heels and keep your back as vertical as possible.
At the bottom, touch your heels with your hands and come up, lowering your heels again, with your arms straight out in front of your chest.
Swing your arms back, as if rowing, to start the next rep.
sentadilla-trasera-barra: Set the bar in the rack slightly below shoulder height and step under it to rest it on your upper back.
Grip it with your hands wider than your shoulders, push your chest out, squeeze your shoulder blades together, lift it off the rack and take a step back.
With your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, push your hips back and lower yourself with your back straight until your hips are below your knees.
Push the floor away with your feet and drive your hips forward to stand up again.
sentadilla-frontal-barra: Rest the bar on your upper chest, across the front of your shoulders, and hold it with your arms crossed.
Keep your head and back straight, your abs firm and your toes turned slightly out.
Lower yourself slowly until your thighs are parallel to the floor and come back up slowly.
sentadilla-multipower: Set the Smith machine bar at shoulder height and rest it across your upper back.
Set your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, with your knees and toes turned slightly out.
Draw your abs in and lower yourself slowly by bending your knees and hips, as if you were going to sit down, as far as you can control without tipping onto your toes.
Pause at the bottom and rise slowly until you are standing.
sentadilla-al-banco-barra: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar on your shoulders as you lift it off the rack.
With your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, lower yourself slowly by bending your knees and hips until your glutes lightly touch the bench.
Do not sit on the bench: pause and come back up slowly.
sentadilla-por-encima-cabeza: Set your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, with your toes turned slightly out.
Hold the bar above your head with a very wide grip and your arms and elbows fully straight.
Without lowering the bar, bend your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor, with your abs firm and your chest high.
Come back up with your feet firmly on the floor.
sentadilla-sumo-barra: With the bar resting on your shoulders, set your feet well wider than your shoulders and turn your toes out about 45 degrees.
With your back straight, lower yourself slowly by bending your knees and hips, as if sitting down, until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Come back up by pushing and straightening your legs.
sentadilla-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and set your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, with your knees and toes turned slightly out.
Draw your abs in and lower yourself slowly by bending your knees and hips, as if sitting down, as far as you can control without tipping onto your toes.
Pause at the bottom and come back up slowly.
sentadilla-goblet: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell upright in front of your chest.
With your elbows close to your ribs and your back straight, squat down until your hips are below your knees.
Push the floor away with both feet to come back up.
sentadilla-frontal-mancuernas: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height, just below your chin.
With your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and your heels down, push your hips back and lower yourself until your elbows touch your knees.
Push up through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top.
sentadilla-sumo-mancuerna: Set your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, with your toes turned out about 45 degrees.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in the centre of your body, with your knees slightly bent and your back straight.
Lower yourself as if you were going to sit on a chair until your thighs are parallel to the floor and return under control.
sentadilla-cinturon: Put the belt around your hips and attach it to the machine or the load, so that the weight hangs from your hips and not your back.
Squat down through the full range with your torso upright.
Come up by pushing the floor away with your midfoot.
sentadilla-sissy-disco: Hold on to a support or a bar with one hand and hold a weight plate against your chest with the other.
With your abs firm and your feet firmly planted, lower your body towards the floor until your knees are almost fully bent.
Come back up to the starting position.
sentadilla-hack-maquina: Position yourself in the machine with your back against the backrest and your shoulders under the pads.
Place your feet facing forward, slightly closer together than your shoulders and with your toes turned slightly out; release the safety catches and grip the handles.
With your abs firm, straighten up until you are standing and lower yourself by bending your knees, as if you were going to sit down.
Come back up to the starting position.
sentadilla-hack-barra: Place the bar on the floor just behind your legs and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you with your palms facing back.
Lift it by straightening your hips and knees, without quite locking your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the floor and come up slowly.
prensa-piernas: Sit with your back and tailbone against the backrest and your feet flat on the platform, so that your knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Grip the handles, brace your abs and push the platform away by straightening your hips and knees, without locking them or lifting your glutes off the seat.
Pause briefly and let the platform come back slowly, without your thighs pressing into your ribs.
prensa-piernas-una-pierna: Position yourself in the leg press as in the normal version, but with only one foot on the platform.
Push with that leg until it is almost straight, without locking your knee or lifting your glutes off the seat.
Let the platform come back slowly and, when you finish, repeat with the other leg.
prensa-piernas-pies-juntos: Sit in the leg press and place your feet on the platform very close together, about a foot’s width apart.
Grip the handles, release the safety catches and lower the weight by bending your knees until they form a right angle.
Push back up to the top without locking your knees.
extension-cuadriceps-maquina: Adjust the seat so that your knees can move through their full range, with the roller pad resting just above your ankles.
Grip the handles and keep your hips and back against the backrest.
Straighten your legs slowly until your knees are straight, without locking them, and hold for an instant.
Return under control to the starting position, without swinging the weight.
extension-rodilla-pie-banda: Standing knee extension with a band
Attach the band or cable to your ankle with the anchor behind you and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Brace your abs and lift your foot 2.5 to 5 centimetres off the floor, balancing on your other leg.
Straighten your knee until your leg is straight or to your comfortable limit, without moving your hips or torso.
Lower your leg slowly; if you need to, hold on to a stable support.
extension-rodilla-sentado: Sit upright on a chair or a bench.
Slowly straighten and lift one leg, with your foot turned slightly out.
Tighten your thigh and hold for 5 seconds with the muscle above your knee tensed; then change legs.
cuadriceps-isometrico-toalla: Isometric quadriceps squeeze with a towel
Lie on your back and place a rolled-up towel under your knee.
Tighten your thigh and push your knee down into the towel until it straightens, so that your heel lifts off the floor.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds and relax slowly.
elevacion-pierna-recta: Lie down, or sit slightly reclined, with your legs straight.
Tighten the muscle at the front of your thigh and push your knee down to keep it straight.
Keeping it tight, lift your whole leg off the floor, hold for 5 seconds and lower it slowly.
sentarse-levantarse: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair or a bench, with your feet hip-width apart and your body leaning slightly forward.
Stand up slowly using your legs, not your arms, and looking straight ahead.
Once standing, sit back down as slowly as you can, without using your hands if possible.
sentarse-levantarse-pie-adelantado: Sit on a sturdy chair placed against the wall, with your arms crossed and one foot in front of the other.
Stand up until you are upright.
Sit back down slowly and under control.
sentadilla-isometrica-pared: Rest your back against a smooth wall and slide down while walking your feet away from the wall.
Stop when your thighs are parallel to the floor, with your knees and hips bent at a right angle.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and hold the position for 30 seconds.
sentadilla-deslizando-pared: Rest your back against a wall with your feet about 30 centimetres from it, turned slightly out, and your knees hip-width apart.
Slowly bend your knees, sliding your back down the wall, with your knees in line with your feet and not going past your toes.
As you come up, tighten the muscle above your knee and your glutes.
sentadilla-salto: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, push your hips back and lower yourself by bending your knees until your heels are about to lift.
After a very brief pause, jump up, fully straightening your ankles, knees and hips.
Land softly on your midfoot, shift your weight to your heels and push your hips back to absorb the landing, without locking your knees.
salto-rodillas-pecho: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, push your hips back and lower yourself until your heels are about to lift.
Jump powerfully and, in the air, bring your knees towards your chest and your heels towards your glutes.
Land softly on your midfoot, roll back onto your heels and lower your hips to absorb the landing, without locking your knees.
salto-cajon: Stand about 10 centimetres from a low box, on a non-slip floor, with your feet hip-width apart or closer.
Push your hips back, lower yourself until your heels are about to lift and jump up and forward, driving with your arms.
Land softly on the box with your whole foot, your hips back and your knees slightly bent, and step down from the box.
salto-horizontal: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, push your hips back and bend your knees with your arms stretched back.
Drive forward and up with your feet side by side, swinging your arms over your head.
Look at your landing spot and land softly with your feet side by side, first on the balls of your feet and then on your heels, bending your hips and knees.
impulso-alterno-escalon: Facing a step, put your right foot on it and leave your left on the floor, with your torso leaning slightly forward.
Push hard through your top foot, straightening your ankle, knee and hip, and help yourself by swinging your arms.
In the air, switch legs and land softly with your left foot on top and your right on the floor, with your hips back.
At first, stop between jumps to reset.
sentadilla-una-pierna: With your right foot slightly forward, put your weight on it and let only the toes of your left foot touch the floor for balance.
Brace your abs and lean forward from the hips with your back flat, pushing your hips back while you bend your right knee.
With your pelvis level and your standing foot flat, push through it to come back up, then change legs.
sentadilla-pistol: Stand on one leg, with the other stretched out in front and your arms extended at shoulder height.
Brace your abs, look straight ahead and slowly squat down on your standing leg, with your back and your other leg straight.
Come up slowly by straightening your bent knee, without lowering your free leg or your arms.
sentadilla-camaron: Standing on one leg, bend your other knee and keep that foot behind you.
Lower yourself slowly by bending your standing leg until your back knee touches the floor.
Push up through your standing leg; to make it harder, hold the heel of your back leg with your hand.
curl-nordico-inverso: Kneel with your arms crossed over your chest and your torso upright.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep your hips extended and your torso rigid.
Without bending at the hips, lean back slowly by bending your knees as far as you can control.
Straighten your knees to return to the starting position.
subida-escalon: Stand facing a step, ideally with a handrail or a wall nearby for support.
Put one foot on the step and push through that leg until you bring the other foot up next to it.
Step down slowly and under control to the starting position, and alternate the leg you step up with.
subida-banco-mancuernas: Place a bench, box or step in front of you and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Put your left leg on the bench, step up and then bring your right leg up next to it.
Step down in the same order and, on the next rep, start with the other leg; use a light weight until you have mastered the movement.
subida-banco-barra: Place a bench, box or step in front of you and rest the bar on your shoulders with a wide grip.
Step up onto the bench with one leg and then bring the other up next to it.
Step down in the same order and alternate the leading leg; use a light weight until you have mastered the movement.
bajada-escalon: Stand on one leg on the bottom step of a staircase, facing down the stairs.
Slowly bend your standing knee and let your other foot drop in front of the edge until your heel lightly touches the floor.
Keep your shoulders over your hips and your knee in line with your foot, and come back up by straightening your leg.
lanzamiento-balon-pared: Holding a medicine ball, stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
As you come up, throw the ball against the wall as high as you can and catch it.
estiramiento-cuadriceps-tumbado: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right hand.
Hold the top of your left foot and gently bring your heel towards your left glute, with your knees together.
Hold for 15 to 20 seconds and repeat on the other side.
estiramiento-cuadriceps-de-pie: Stand and hold on to a sturdy support with one hand.
Bend one knee and bring your heel towards your glutes; if you cannot reach it with your hand, loop a towel around your ankle and pull on it.
With your back straight, stop when you feel the stretch at the front of your thigh, hold for 20 to 30 seconds and change legs.
estiramiento-flexor-cadera-rodillas: Kneel with your left knee on the floor below your hip and your right foot in front, with your right knee over your ankle.
Rest your hands on your right thigh, brace your abs and keep your pelvis level without arching your lower back.
Lean forward into your right hip and squeeze your left glute to feel the stretch more.
Hold for 30 to 45 seconds and change sides.
curl-femoral-tumbado: Lie face down on the machine with your knees aligned with the pivot and the roller pad just below your calves, not touching your heels.
Grip the handles and brace your abs so that your lower back does not move.
Bend your knees and bring the roller pad towards your glutes under control, without arching your back.
Pause briefly and return slowly to the starting position.
curl-femoral-tumbado-una-pierna: Position yourself on the lying leg curl machine as in the two-leg version.
Bend only one knee and bring the roller pad towards your glute under control, without arching your back.
Return slowly and, when you finish, repeat with the other leg.
curl-femoral-sentado: Sit with your legs straight on the roller pad, set just above your heels, and secure the thigh pad over your thighs, above your knees.
With your abs firm and your torso still, bend your knees, bringing the roller pad towards the back of your thighs.
Hold for a moment and return slowly to the starting position.
curl-femoral-de-pie-maquina: Adjust the machine’s roller pad so that it sits just above your ankle.
Grip the machine’s handles and brace your abs.
Slowly bring your foot towards your glute, return to the starting position and, when you finish, change legs.
curl-femoral-de-pie-polea: Set the cable at the lowest position and fasten the ankle strap just above your left ankle.
Facing the machine, put your weight on your right foot and hold on to the machine if you need to.
Lift your left foot and bring your heel towards your glute, pause at the top and lower it slowly.
curl-femoral-de-pie-sin-peso: Stand upright and hold on to a support if you need to.
Bend one knee and bring your heel towards your glute, with your knees aligned.
Return slowly and repeat with the other leg; to make it harder, hold at the top for one or two seconds.
curl-femoral-de-pie-banda: Standing in front of a stable support, loop the band around one ankle and stand on the other end with the opposite foot.
Bend your knee and bring your foot towards your glute.
Lower it slowly, controlling the return.
curl-femoral-fitball: Lie on your back with your calves and heels on the exercise ball, your arms out to the sides and your abs firm.
Squeeze your glutes and raise your hips until your hips, torso and legs are in line.
Without lowering your hips, bend your knees and roll the ball in until the soles of your feet are on it.
Straighten your legs slowly and lower your hips; do not raise them so high that your lower back arches.
curl-femoral-fitball-una-pierna: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the exercise ball, and raise your hips by pushing through your heels.
Lift one straight leg up from the hip.
Bend the knee of the leg that stays on the ball and bring your heel in while raising your hips further.
Straighten it slowly until you form a straight line, without lowering the raised leg.
curl-isquios-toalla: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet hip-width apart, resting on a towel.
Brace your abs and lift your glutes until your hips are in line with your knees.
Slide your heels away to straighten your knees and return slowly to the starting position.
curl-nordico: Kneel on a mat with your torso upright and a straight line from ear to knee; ask someone to hold your ankles or hook them under a fixed support.
With your torso and pelvis firm, let your knees straighten and fall forward slowly, braking with your hamstrings.
Near the floor, put your hands down to brake the end and stop about 5 centimetres from it.
Push with your hands as in a press-up and pull with your hamstrings to return to the top.
elevacion-gluteo-isquio: Place your ankles between the rollers, your feet on the platform and your thighs on the pad, just above your knees, with your arms crossed.
Start with your knees bent at about 90 degrees and your torso vertical, with your shoulders, hips and knees in line.
Slowly straighten your knees and, near horizontal, bend at the hips over the pad until your torso is pointing almost straight down.
To come up, first extend your hips and, at horizontal, bend your knees until you are back in the starting position.
peso-muerto-rumano-barra: Hold the bar with both hands, shoulder-width apart, resting against the front of your thighs.
With your knees slightly bent and your back straight, push your hips back as you lower the bar close to your legs.
Stop when you feel tension at the back of your legs, roughly at mid-calf.
To come up, push the floor away with your heels and drive your hips forward, keeping the bar very close to your body.
peso-muerto-rumano-mancuernas: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
With your back straight, lean forward by pushing your hips back and lower the dumbbells close to your legs.
Stand up again by extending your hips.
peso-muerto-rumano-polea: Hold a cable in each hand and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with a medium resistance and your knees slightly bent.
Lean forward by bending at the hips and let the cable draw your hands slowly towards your feet.
Extend your hips to come back up, with your back straight the whole time.
peso-muerto-piernas-rigidas: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grip the bar overhand with your hands the same width apart.
With your legs and back straight, lean forward from the hips and lower the bar towards the tops of your feet.
Come back up by extending your hips and, if your shoulders have rounded, draw them back at the end.
peso-muerto-rumano-escalonado: Hold the bar in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, resting only the toes of that foot for balance.
With almost all your weight on your front leg, push your hips back with your back straight and lower the bar as in the Romanian deadlift.
Come back up by extending your hips and, when you finish, change legs.
peso-muerto-barra: Stand behind the bar with your feet between hip-width and shoulder-width apart and your shins against it.
Push your hips back slightly with your back straight and your chest high, bend forward and grip the bar with one palm facing up and the other facing down.
Squeeze the bar, push the floor away with your feet and, with your back flat, drive your hips forward until you are standing with your shoulders back.
To lower it, push your hips back with your back straight and let your knees bend, slowing the weight with your thighs.
peso-muerto-una-pierna: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, your back long and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lift your left foot, stretching that leg out behind you with your back straight.
Lean forward to a comfortable distance; if you need to, hold on to a stable support.
Come back up by squeezing your right glute and, when you finish, change legs.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-mancuerna: Stand on your left leg with a dumbbell in your right hand, your left knee slightly bent and your back straight.
Lean forward from your left hip, taking your right leg back, straight and with your toes pointed, for balance.
With your right arm straight, let the dumbbell drop vertically in front of your standing leg.
Push the floor away with your left foot, lower your right leg as you come up and pause in balance before repeating.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-kettlebell: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on one leg.
Lean forward from the hips until the kettlebell touches the floor.
Stand up again by extending your hips.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-polea: Set the cable at the lowest position with a handle attached and stand facing the machine.
Put your weight on your right leg, grip the handle with your left hand and keep that arm straight, your right knee slightly bent and your back straight.
Lean forward from your right hip, reaching your straight left arm forward.
Push through your right foot to come back up, lowering your left leg while pulling the handle towards your hip.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-banda: Anchor the band at a low point, for example on a wall, and hold a handle in each hand.
Step back until you feel medium resistance and bend the knee of the working leg slightly.
Lean forward from the hips with your arms straight, reaching forward as you go down, and extend your hips to return; finish one leg before changing.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-salto: Standing, take your right foot back; if your balance is good, keep it in the air.
Lower your torso until it is almost horizontal, with your right hand reaching towards the floor and your right foot at hip height.
Come up and jump powerfully, driving your right knee up and your left arm above your head; finish one side before changing.
buenos-dias-barra: Rest a barbell on your shoulders.
With your head up and your back completely straight, bend forward from the waist until your back is parallel to the floor.
buenos-dias-sin-peso: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and your hands on your hips.
Lean your torso towards the floor by bending at the hips, with your back straight.
Come back up to the starting position.
buenos-dias-piernas-abiertas: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and your toes turned slightly out, and put your hands behind your head.
Lean your torso towards the floor by bending at the hips, with your back straight and your chest open.
hiperextension-inversa-banco: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging, holding on to the bench.
With your knees together, raise your legs until they form a straight line with your torso, using your glutes rather than your lower back.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
patadas-alternas-banco: Prone flutter kicks on a bench
Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold on to it, letting your legs and feet hang.
Draw your abs in and squeeze your glutes and hamstrings.
Take one leg back and up without lifting your hips off the bench, and alternate legs.
isometrico-isquios-sentado: Sit on a chair or a bench with your feet on the floor.
Move one heel slightly forward and push it down and back towards the chair, without your foot moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, relax and repeat with the other leg.
balanceo-pierna: Stand next to a wall or a stable support.
Swing one leg forward and back in a controlled way, with your torso upright and your abs firm.
estiramiento-isquios-tumbado: Lie on your back and raise one leg, holding it with both hands behind the knee.
With your other knee bent and that foot on the floor, pull the raised leg towards you, keeping it straight.
Hold for 15 to 20 seconds and change sides.
estiramiento-isquios-escalon: Hamstring stretch with one foot on a step
Standing upright, rest one foot on a step.
With your back straight, lean forward slowly from the hips until you feel the stretch at the back of your thigh.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and change legs.
estiramiento-isquios-sentado: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front and the other bent towards you.
Lengthen your back, turn your torso slightly towards the straight leg and lean forward gently, trying to touch your toes.
Hold for 10 to 30 seconds and change sides.
estiramiento-isquios-silla: Seated hamstring stretch on a chair
Sit on the edge of a chair or a bench, with one leg bent and the other straight, your heel on the floor and your foot turned slightly out.
With your back straight, lean forward from the hips towards the straight leg while tightening your thigh muscle.
Hold for 15 seconds and change legs.
elevacion-talones-de-pie: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and, if you need to, hold on to the back of a chair or a wall.
Raise your heels slowly until you are on your tiptoes, as high as is comfortable.
Lower under control; to make it harder, repeat it without holding on.
elevacion-talones-escalon: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it and your heels in the air.
Raise your heels as far as is comfortable and pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, holding on to a handrail or the wall if you need to.
elevacion-talon-una-pierna: Hold on to a support, such as a chair or a wall, and lift one foot off the floor.
With the knee of your standing leg straight and your body upright, raise your heel as high as you can.
Pause briefly, lower slowly and repeat with the other leg.
elevacion-talon-una-pierna-escalon: Single-leg calf raise on a step
Rest the ball of one foot on the edge of a step and hook your other foot behind your ankle.
Raise your heel as far as is comfortable and pause briefly.
Lower slowly, without dropping, and repeat with the other leg.
elevacion-talones-bajada-una-pierna: Rise onto your tiptoes on both feet, holding on to a table or the wall.
Shift your weight onto one leg, lift the other and keep your heel up for a moment without letting it drop.
Lower slowly on that leg until your heel is down and repeat, changing sides.
elevacion-talones-escalon-mancuerna: Dumbbell calf raise on a step
Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step and a dumbbell in one hand.
Hold on to the wall or a handrail with your other hand and raise your heels as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly and lower slowly until you feel the stretch in your calf.
elevacion-talones-maquina-de-pie: Position yourself in the machine with your shoulders under the pads and the balls of your feet on the platform, with your heels free.
With your body upright and your knees straight, raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly and lower slowly until your calf is fully stretched.
elevacion-talones-barra: Lift the bar off the rack resting on your upper back, step back and set your feet hip-width apart.
With your chest high and your knees slightly bent, push through the balls of your feet and raise your heels.
Pause at the top and lower your heels slowly.
elevacion-talones-prensa: Sit in the leg press or the calf machine, with the safety catches on, and rest only the balls of your feet on the platform.
With your legs straight, push with your toes as far as you can without bending your knees.
Let the platform come back slowly, bringing your toes towards you.
