elevacion-talones-hack: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back firmly against the backrest and the front half of your feet on the edge of the platform.
With your knees straight, raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower in a smooth movement until your calf is fully stretched.
elevacion-talones-banda: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with the balls of your feet and bring the ends up to shoulder height.
Rise onto your tiptoes, keeping your hands next to your shoulders.
Pause briefly and lower your heels to the floor.
flexion-plantar-banda: Sit with one leg straight and loop a resistance band around the sole of your foot, holding the ends with your hands.
With your knee straight, push your toes forward, moving only your ankle.
Pause briefly and return slowly to the starting position.
elevacion-talones-sentado-maquina: Sit on the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and your thighs under the pad, just above your knees.
Release the safety catch and raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly and lower slowly until your calf is stretched.
elevacion-talones-sentado-barra: Place a block on the floor in front of a bench and sit with a barbell resting on your thighs.
Rest the balls of your feet on the block.
Raise and lower your heels slowly as far as you can, without your feet leaving the block.
elevacion-talones-sentado-mancuernas: Sit on a bench with your knees bent at a right angle and the balls of your feet on the edge of a step.
Place the dumbbells on your knees and raise your heels as far as is comfortable.
elevacion-talon-sentado-una-pierna: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell on one thigh and the ball of that foot on a block or step.
Raise and lower your heel slowly as far as you can, without your foot leaving the block.
When you finish, move the dumbbell to the other side and repeat with the other foot.
elevacion-talones-sentado: Sit on a chair or a bench with your knees at a right angle and your feet flat on the floor.
Raise your heels, putting your weight on the base of your big toes, and lower them again.
Repeat at a comfortable pace; to increase the load, rest your elbows on your knees and push down.
elevacion-tibial-de-pie: Stand upright with your feet flat on the floor.
Lift the front of your feet so that you are resting only on your heels, and lower them again slowly.
toques-puntas-sentado: Sit on a chair or a bench with your knees at a right angle and your feet flat on the floor.
Lift your toes without lifting your heels and lower them again, in a continuous tapping motion.
flexion-dorsal-banda: Sit upright with one leg straight and loop around your foot a resistance band tied to a sturdy point in front of you.
Starting with your toes pointed, bring them towards your shin, moving only your ankle.
Return slowly to the starting position, without bending or locking your knee.
saltos-pogo: Stand upright with your feet between hip-width and shoulder-width apart and your knees only just bent.
Do small, quick jumps, driving mainly with your ankles and the balls of your feet.
Spend as little time as possible on the floor and do not let your heels touch it.
saltos-pogo-altos: Set up as for pogo jumps, with your feet apart and your knees almost straight.
Jump for more height, driving with your ankles and without putting your heels down.
Keep your contacts with the floor as short as possible.
saltos-pogo-laterales: Set up as for pogo jumps, on the balls of your feet.
Move sideways with short, quick jumps driven by your ankles, without putting your heels down.
At the end of the stretch, jump back in the opposite direction.
saltos-laterales-una-pierna: Standing on one leg, push off to one side and land on the other.
Regain your balance before jumping back to the opposite side.
estiramiento-gemelo-pared: Stand facing a wall, rest your hands on it and take one leg back with the knee straight.
Bend your front knee and keep both feet flat, with your back heel on the floor, until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 15 to 20 seconds and change legs.
estiramiento-soleo-pared: Stand facing the wall as in the calf stretch, with one leg back and the heel on the floor.
Bend your back knee slightly, without lifting your heel, until you feel the stretch in your lower calf.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and change legs.
estiramiento-pantorrilla-toalla: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop a towel around the sole of your foot, holding one end in each hand.
Gently pull the towel towards you, with your knee straight, until you feel the stretch in your calf.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and change legs.
estiramiento-soleo-escalon: Rest a whole foot on a step, facing forward, and hold on to the handrail or the wall if you need to.
Without lifting your heel off the step, bring your knee forward until you feel the stretch in your lower calf.
Hold for about 10 seconds and repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-tibial-rodillas: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and the tops of your feet on the floor, with your toes pointing back.
With your torso upright, slowly take your hips back towards your heels and rest your fingertips on the floor behind you.
Hold for 15 to 30 seconds; if you feel discomfort in your knees, come out of the stretch slowly.
estiramiento-tobillo-sentado: Sit upright on a chair or a bench and hold on to the seat with your hands.
Straighten one leg and lift it off the floor.
Point your toes forward and then pull them towards you, and repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-pecho-silla-rotacion: Seated chest stretch with torso rotation
Sit near the front edge of a chair.
With the arm on the side you are going to stretch, hold the side of the seat or the armrest, or rest your forearm over the back of the chair if that is comfortable.
Rotate your upper body away from that arm until you feel the stretch in your chest.
Hold, then turn back to face forward to come out of the stretch.
estiramiento-pecho-tumbado-toalla-cactus: Chest stretch on a towel with cactus arms
Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet hip-width apart; tuck your chin in and relax your shoulders.
Stretch your arms out to the sides and bend your elbows so that each arm forms an L, with your palms facing up.
If you do not feel a gentle stretch in your shoulders and chest, place tightly rolled towels under your spine, from your tailbone to your head.
Relax in that position for at least 15 to 30 seconds, breathing normally.
estiramiento-pecho-tumbado-toalla-t: Chest stretch on a towel with arms in a T
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet hip-width apart; tuck your chin in and relax your shoulders.
Stretch your arms out to the sides, in a T.
If you do not feel a gentle stretch in your shoulders and chest, place a tightly rolled towel under your spine, from your tailbone to your head.
Relax in that position for at least 15 to 30 seconds, breathing normally, without holding your breath.
flexion-inclinada-mesa: Incline press-up with hands on the worktop
Place your hands on the edge of a worktop or a sturdy table and walk your feet back until your body is at an angle.
With your back and legs in a straight line, lower your chest towards the worktop.
Push back up. The lower the surface, the harder it will be.
flexion-inclinada-silla: Incline press-up with hands on a chair
Place a sturdy chair without wheels against the wall and rest your hands on the edge of the seat.
Walk your feet back and, with your back and legs in a straight line, lower your chest towards the seat.
Push with your arms to return to the top.
presion-palmas-subiendo-manos: Palm squeeze, raising the hands from the navel
Place a ball or something else you can squeeze, such as a rolled-up towel, between your palms, at navel height.
Squeeze it hard and, without easing the pressure, raise it very slowly as far as you can.
Lower it very slowly to your navel and repeat without resting.
flexion-declinada-silla: Decline press-up with feet on a chair
Place a sturdy chair without wheels against the wall, rest your feet on the seat and your hands on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
With your body in a straight line and your elbows pointing back, lower your chest under control until it is close to the floor.
estiramiento-pecho-manos-entrelazadas-es: Chest stretch with hands clasped behind the back
Standing, interlace your fingers behind your back.
With your arms straight, lift them up and back behind you until you feel the stretch in your shoulders, chest or arms.
press-suelo-botellas: Lie on your back on the floor with a full bottle or a tin in each hand.
With your abs engaged and your elbows just below your shoulders, without flaring them out to the sides, push your arms up.
flexion-despegue-manos: Hand-release press-up with arms in a T
Lie face down with your hands on the floor and push your whole body up in one go until your elbows are straight, in a high plank, with your body straight from head to ankles.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself to the floor, so that your chest, hips and thighs touch down at the same time.
Without moving your head, body or legs, lift your hands off the floor and open your arms out to the sides in a T; then put your hands back on the floor to start the next rep.
flexion-mochila: Put on a backpack with some weight in it, fitted snugly to your back.
Place your hands shoulder-width apart or slightly closer, with your body in a straight line, resting on your knees or, if you can, on your toes.
Lower your chest under control until it is close to the floor, with your elbows tucked into your sides and pointing back, and push back up.
flexion-una-pierna: Get into a high plank with your hands below your shoulders and your fingers spread, your feet together and your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor and, at the same time, lift one straight leg until your toes are level with your other heel or slightly above it, but no higher.
Push back up to the plank with both feet down and alternate legs on each rep.
flexion-en-t-ocho-tiempos: From a position of attention, squat down, place your hands on the floor and kick your legs back into a high plank.
Bend your elbows until you reach the floor and open your arms out to the sides in a T position; your hands can stay on the floor or be lifted off it.
Push up from the floor to a high plank, with your body straight from head to heels.
Bring your legs in to a squat and stand up.
cierre-brazos-biosaludable: Seated chest fly on the outdoor gym machine
Sit on the machine and grip the handles.
Bring your arms forward in an arc until the handles meet in front of your face.
press-pecho-biosaludable: Seated chest press on the outdoor gym machine
Sit with your back against the backrest, your knees and hips at right angles and your feet hip-width apart.
Grip the handles at chest height, with your arms open and your elbows pointing out to the sides and slightly up.
Push forward until your arms are extended to a comfortable distance, without locking your elbows or lifting your back off the seat.
Pause and return slowly to the starting position.
aperturas-banco-parque-botellas: Bottle fly on a park bench
With a full bottle in each hand, lie on your back along a flat park bench with no backrest, with your feet firmly on the ground.
Draw your shoulders down and back so that your back is well supported, and raise the bottles with your arms straight, shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and lower both bottles slowly at the same time in a wide arc, until they are level with your shoulders or chest.
Raise them slowly along the same arc back to the starting position.
press-banca-banco-parque-botellas: Bench press on a park bench with bottles
With a full bottle in each hand, lie on your back along a flat park bench without a backrest, with your feet firmly on the ground.
Draw your shoulders down and back so that your back is well supported on the seat.
Slowly lower both bottles at the same time towards the middle of your chest and press them up gently until your elbows are straight.
estiramiento-dorsal-codos-silla: Lat stretch with elbows on a chair
Kneel in front of a chair, with your knees directly below your hips, and rest your elbows on the seat with your palms facing each other and your fingers pointing at the ceiling.
Draw your abs in and round your back slightly, as in the cat pose.
Move your hips slightly back towards your feet and try to lower your armpits and chest towards the floor.
estiramiento-dorsal-de-pie-mesa: Standing lat stretch with hands on a table
Standing facing a sturdy table or worktop, rest your hands on it.
Take a few steps back and lower your chest towards the floor by bending at the hips.
With your arms straight and your head between them, feel the stretch along your sides and in your shoulders.
Hold for a few breaths and slowly come back up to standing.
isometrico-dorsal-apretando-cadera: Isometric lat squeeze with a towel against the hip
Place a ball or something else you can squeeze, such as a rolled-up towel, between your hip and the palm of your hand, with your elbow directly above your hand.
Squeeze it as hard as you can for 20 seconds without losing the position.
Then do it with the other arm.
remo-una-mano-bolsa-mesa: Standing single-arm row with a bag, supported on a table
Standing, lean forward and rest one hand on a sturdy table; with the other, hold a bag with some items in it, with your arm hanging straight and relaxed.
Choose a weight that provides resistance but that you can lift without straining.
Bend your elbow, taking it behind your back, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bag again slowly and under control.
remo-una-mano-de-pie-apoyado-mesa: Standing single-arm row, supported on a table
Standing, support yourself with one hand on a table or a sturdy chair and let your other arm hang down, with a full bottle of water in that hand.
With your back straight, step forward with the foot on the side of your supporting hand and lean your torso forward, bending that knee.
Bend your elbow, driving it back behind your back, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the starting position and, when you finish, change sides.
remo-botella-rodilla-en-silla: Single-arm row with a bottle, one knee on a chair
Rest one knee on the seat of a sturdy chair and the hand on that side on the back of the chair; keep your other leg straight on the floor and hold a bottle of water with your free arm straight.
With your back straight and your abs slightly tightened, drive the elbow of the arm holding the bottle back, close to your torso, until it reaches shoulder height.
Keep your head in line with your back and slowly straighten your arm again. When you finish, change sides.
estiramiento-brazos-arriba-manos-entrela: Overhead arm stretch with hands clasped
Standing or sitting, interlace your fingers in front of your body.
Stretch your arms upwards, as if trying to touch the ceiling, until your hands are above your head.
Hold the position for 10 to 12 seconds and relax.
estiramiento-lateral-brazos-arriba: Side torso stretch with arms overhead
Stand with your legs slightly apart, interlace your fingers and raise your arms close to your ears, stretching them towards the ceiling.
Without lowering your arms, lean your torso to one side until you feel the stretch along your side.
Hold for at least 20 to 30 seconds and repeat on the other side.
postura-nino-lateral: Child’s pose with torso to one side
Kneeling, breathe in through your nose and, as you breathe out through your mouth, bend your knees and hips until you are sitting on your heels with your neck relaxed.
Slide your hands forward along the floor.
To focus the stretch on one side of your body, move your torso and hands to one side; hold for 5 to 10 seconds and repeat to the other side.
remo-botella-apoyo-pared: Single-arm row with a bottle, supported on the wall
Stand with one foot forward and that knee bent, your other leg straight behind you and your back straight, and rest one hand on the wall.
With your other hand, hold a full bottle of water, with your palm facing in and your arm straight down.
Bring the bottle towards your armpit, driving your elbow back, and straighten your arm again. When you finish, change sides.
estiramiento-espalda-manos-pared: Back stretch with hands on the wall
Stand facing a wall, about a metre away, and place your hands on it with your arms fully straight.
Lean your torso forward until it is parallel to the floor, with your legs straight, and feel the stretch in your back and the backs of your legs.
To make it harder, cross your legs, push down and back, shifting your weight onto your heels, and hold for 20 seconds; repeat with the other leg in front.
remo-inclinado-bolsas: Split the weight evenly between two shopping bags and pick one up in each hand.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with your back straight and your abs firm.
Bend your elbows and lift the bags towards your chest, with your elbows close to your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
remo-inclinado-garrafas: Bent-over row with two large water bottles
Stand with your feet comfortably apart, hold a large water bottle with a handle in each hand and tighten your abs.
Bend your knees and lean your torso forward from the hips with your back very straight and your arms reaching straight down towards the floor.
Slowly raise the bottles until your elbows are just below your shoulders, without letting your shoulders roll forward.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
remo-inclinado-mochila: Place the backpack on the floor in front of you, loaded with only as much weight as you can lift comfortably, and hold it by the sides with both hands.
Lean your torso forward from the hips with your abs firm, your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the backpack towards your belly button with your elbows close to your sides.
Lower it under control to shin height and repeat.
remo-inclinado-supino-botellas: Standing, hold a bottle of water in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with your back straight and your abs firm.
Raise the bottles towards your torso with your elbows close to your ribs and your traps relaxed.
Lower them more slowly than you raised them.
remo-una-mano-garrafa-banco-parque-de-pi: Single-arm row with a large water bottle, supported on a park bench
Stand next to a park bench with your feet hip-width apart and rest one hand on the seat to steady yourself.
With your other hand, pick up a large plastic water bottle with a handle and keep your body in a diagonal line, with your shoulders slightly higher than your hips.
With your arm tucked in close to your body, pull your elbow up.
Lower your arm slowly and under control and, when you finish, change sides.
tirar-empujar-barra-biosaludable: Seated bar pull and push on the outdoor gym machine
Sit with your back against the backrest and your legs shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar, pull it towards you and push it away again.
remo-una-mano-mochila-banco-parque: Single-arm row with a backpack, supported on a park bench
Load the backpack with only as much weight as you can lift comfortably and rest one knee and the hand on the same side on the seat of a park bench.
With your back flat and your head in line with your spine, hold the backpack in your other hand and let that arm hang straight towards the ground.
Pull the backpack up by bending your elbow and taking your arm back, without twisting your torso or moving your back.
Lower it gently to the starting position and, when you finish, change sides.
apertura-diagonal-banda-sentado: Sit on a chair and hold a resistance band by the ends, wrapping it around your hands to grip it securely.
With your hands at knee height, pull your arms apart diagonally, straightening your elbows.
Return to the starting position. Choose a band that allows you to do the exercise correctly.
aperturas-toalla: Hold a towel with both hands and open your arms at chest height.
Pull outwards, as if you were trying to separate your hands, and try to hold the contraction for about 3 seconds.
Relax without letting go of the towel and repeat.
encogimientos-sentado-silla-botellas: Seated bottle shrug on a chair
Sit upright on a sturdy chair without armrests, with a water bottle in each hand and your arms hanging at your sides, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Raise your shoulders up and back until you feel the muscles in your neck contract.
Hold for a moment at the top and lower them slowly.
estiramiento-cuello-sujetando-silla: Side neck stretch holding the seat
Sit comfortably and hold the seat of the chair with one hand.
With your chin slightly tucked in, slowly tilt your head towards the opposite side until you feel a gentle stretch.
gato-vaca-silla: Sit on a chair with your fingers interlaced behind your head.
Bring your chest and head towards your thighs to round your back, breathing calmly.
Then take your shoulders and head up, towards the top of the back of the chair, to arch your back.
giro-tronco-sentado: Sit upright on a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, and cross your arms so that your hands touch your shoulders.
Without moving your hips, rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable and hold for 5 seconds.
Return to the centre and repeat to the other side.
If the chair has armrests, you can hold the one on the side you are turning towards and place your other hand on the outside of the opposite thigh.
reexpansion-dorsal-toalla: Thoracic re-expansion on a rolled-up towel
Lie on your back with a rolled-up towel under your upper back and your hands behind your head.
Breathe in, trying to expand your ribs, while you take your elbows back.
As you breathe out, return to the starting position.
remo-menton-sentado-silla-latas: Seated upright row on a chair with tins
Sit upright on a sturdy chair, without leaning against the back of the chair, with your feet on the floor and a tin or a small bottle of water in each hand.
With your arms straight at your sides, bend your elbows up and out until your hands are just below your shoulders.
Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed and return to the starting position.
remo-sentado-sin-peso: Sitting on a chair, stretch your arms out in front of you at shoulder height.
Take your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together, and hold for a few seconds.
Stretch your arms out in front of you again at shoulder height.
abrazo-espalda-alta: Sitting down, open your arms out to the sides and reach them out as far as you can.
Then cross them in front of your chest, hugging yourself.
Hold the hug for about 30 seconds and relax.
apertura-codos-manos-nuca: Elbow opener with hands behind the head
Standing tall, bend your elbows and rest your hands lightly on the back of your head.
Open your elbows out to the sides, feeling your shoulder blades slide down and back, towards each other.
elevacion-brazo-pierna-prono: Prone single arm or leg raise
Lie face down with your legs straight, your toes pointing back and your arms stretched out in front of your head, with your palms facing each other and your head relaxed, in line with your back.

Tighten your abs and slowly lift one arm a few centimetres, straight and without rotating it, without arching your back or lifting your head; hold for a moment and lower it without moving your lower back or hips.
As a variation, lift one straight leg a few centimetres in the same way, with your toes pointing back and without rotating it; hold for a moment and return to the starting position.
elevacion-plano-escapular-botellas: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a full bottle in each hand with your arms straight and the bottles resting against your thighs.
Push your feet into the floor and keep your hips level and your back upright.
Raise both arms to shoulder height, angled about 45 degrees out in front of your body, and lower them slowly.
encogimientos-bolsas: Put the same weight in each of two shopping bags and, standing upright, take one in each hand.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and raise your shoulders up and back until you feel the muscles in your neck contract.
Hold for a moment at the top and lower them slowly.
encogimientos-botellas: Stand upright, holding a water bottle in each hand, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Raise your shoulders up and back until you feel the muscles in your neck contract.
Hold for a moment at the top and lower them slowly.
enhebrar-la-aguja: Get on all fours with your hands directly below your shoulders and your knees below your hips.
Lift one hand and slide it under your body towards the opposite side, letting your shoulder drop towards the floor and your chest and head rotate.
Rotate as far as is comfortable, hold the stretch and slowly return to the starting position.
estiramiento-cuello-botella: Side neck stretch holding a bottle
Standing, hold a bottle of water in one hand.
Tilt your head towards the opposite shoulder until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 30 seconds and change sides.
estiramiento-espalda-alta-manos-delante: Upper back stretch with hands in front
Stand or sit with your feet shoulder-width apart, your knees straight but not locked and your fingers interlaced in front of you.
Turn your hands so that your palms face the floor and raise your arms to roughly chest height.
Push your palms away from your body until you feel the stretch in your neck, upper back and shoulders.
giro-cabeza-estiramiento: Sitting or standing, turn your head to one side until you feel some tension in your neck muscles.
Hold the position for 10 to 12 seconds, pause and repeat to the other side.
libro-abierto-tumbado: Lie on your side with your knees drawn up at a right angle in front of your hips and your arms straight out in front of you at chest height, with your palms together.
Squeeze your thighs together so that your pelvis and lower back do not move.
Watching your top hand, slowly move it away and take it up and back towards the floor on the other side, as if forming a T with your torso and arms.
Pause at the end, bring your hands back together and, when you finish, change sides.
nadador: Swimmer (opposite arm and leg, face down)
Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front of your head, your palms on the floor and your toes pointing back.
Lift your left arm and right leg off the floor while you raise your head and arch your back slightly, with your gaze parallel to the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat with the opposite arm and leg.
remo-menton-pie-botellas: Standing upright row with bottles of water
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a bottle of water in each hand with your arms at your sides.
Bend your elbows out to the sides and raise the bottles to chest height, with your neck and shoulders relaxed.
Lower your arms back down beside your body.
remo-prono: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front of your head, your palms facing down and your toes pointing back, and lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Lift your head and chest slightly while you pull your arms back, making fists as they approach your shoulders, with your feet together on the floor.
Reverse the movement until your arms are stretched out in front again, without resting them on the floor.
remo-prono-de-pie: Standing row without weights (arms from overhead to shoulders)
Stand with your legs apart and your arms stretched above your head, with your palms facing forward.
Lift your chin, head and chest slightly while you lower your arms towards your sides by bending your elbows, and make fists as they approach your shoulders.
Raise your arms back to the starting position and repeat.
retraccion-cervical: Standing comfortably, tilt your head forward, bringing your chin towards your chest.
Slide your chin backwards, with your jaw relaxed, and hold the position.
Relax your neck muscles to return to the starting position.
retraccion-cervical-cuatro-patas: Get on all fours in a comfortable position, looking at the floor.
Gently tilt your head, bringing your chin towards your chest, and then slide it back, tucking it in.
Keep your eyes on the same point on the floor and return to the starting position.
retraccion-escapular-codos-altos: Scapular retraction with elbows at shoulder height
Rest your hands on your chest and lift your elbows to shoulder height, with your shoulders relaxed.
Draw your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together, and hold for a moment.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
rotacion-cuadrupedia-mano-nuca: Rotation on all fours with hand behind the head
Get on all fours, with your knees hip-width apart and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Put your right hand behind your head, with your arm and torso facing the floor.
Rotate your torso outwards, lifting your elbow up, return to the starting position, repeat and change sides.
separar-juntar-omoplatos-brazos-al-frent: Shoulder blade spread and squeeze with arms forward
Stretch your arms out in front at shoulder height, as if holding a box.
Without bending your elbows, alternately spread your shoulder blades apart and squeeze them together.
t-isometrica-inclinado: Standing, lean your torso forward by bending at the hips to about 45 degrees.
Draw your abs in to protect your lower back and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Open your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, forming a T with your palms facing down, and hold the position.
tijeras-brazos-omoplatos: Arm scissors with shoulder blades drawn back
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height and cross them.
Then take your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
elevacion-prona-l: Lie face down with your arms on the floor, out at right angles to your torso and with your elbows also bent at right angles.
Lift both arms a few centimetres off the floor without straightening your elbows, so that your elbows, forearms and hands rise at the same time.
Lower them under control and repeat.
pajaros-de-pie-botellas: Standing rear delt fly with tins or bottles
With a tin or a full bottle in each hand, bend your knees, push your hips back and lean your torso forward, with your weight on your heels and your arms hanging towards the floor.
Raise your arms out to the sides, engaging your upper back and shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your hands come back together in the starting position.
zancada-corredor-rotacion: Get into a low lunge, with your right leg back, your left ankle below your knee and one hand on each side of your front foot; to make it easier, rest your right knee on the floor.
Raise your left arm and rotate your torso towards the inside of your left thigh.
Return to the centre, repeat and change sides.
abduccion-isometrica-toalla-pared: Isometric shoulder abduction against a wall with a towel
Stand side-on to a wall, with your arm relaxed by your side.
Place a folded towel between your elbow and the wall.
Push your elbow against the wall to squeeze the towel and hold for about 5 seconds.
Relax and bring your elbow back to your side.
deslizamiento-brazo-mesa-toalla: Table arm slide with a towel
Sit next to a table with your forearm and hand resting on it, on top of a towel, and your elbow just off the edge.
With your elbow as straight as possible, slowly slide your arm forward across the table, bringing your chest down towards the floor.
Lift your chest back up so that your arm slides back to the starting position.
elevacion-brazos-sentado: Sit upright on a chair with your arms at your sides.
With your palms facing forward, raise both arms out to the sides and up as far as is comfortable, then lower them again.
Keep your shoulders down and your arms straight the whole time; breathe out as you raise them and breathe in as you lower them.
elevacion-frontal-sentado-botellas: Seated bottle front raise, turning the palms
Sit on a chair without armrests, with your back straight against the back of the chair, and hold a bottle of water in each hand at your sides, with your palms facing in.
Slowly raise your straight arms in front of you, turning your palms up, until they are parallel to the floor.
Lower them back down to your sides.
elevacion-lateral-sentado-silla-botellas: Seated bottle lateral raise on a chair
Sit on a chair without armrests with your back straight and a container filled with water or sand in each hand, with your arms at your sides.
Slowly raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, at shoulder height.
Hold them up for a moment and lower them to your sides.
estiramiento-hombro-toalla-espalda: Shoulder stretch with a towel behind the back
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, hold one end of a towel in one hand, raise that arm and bend your elbow so that the towel hangs down your back.
Bring your other hand to your lower back and grab the other end of the towel.
Pull the towel down with your bottom hand and stop when you feel the stretch in the shoulder of your top arm.
Then gently pull upwards with your top hand to stretch the shoulder of your bottom arm; hold for about 30 seconds and swap the position of your hands.
pendulo-hombro: Shoulder pendulum supported on a table
Lean forward, rest one hand on a table or a chair and let your other arm hang down.
Gently swing the hanging arm forward and back.
Then move it in small circles, in one direction and then in the other.
If you need to, you can do it sitting on a chair.
punetazos-sentado: Sit upright on a sturdy chair without leaning against the back of the chair, with your feet flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Make fists and hold them in front of your face.
Punch one fist forward and, as you pull it back, punch with the other, alternating arms.
To progress, hold an unopened tin or a small bottle in each hand, or do it standing.
rotacion-externa-botella-toalla: Side-lying external rotation with a bottle
Lie on your side with your top elbow bent at a right angle and tucked into your side.
Place a towel or a piece of clothing between your elbow and your side and hold a small bottle of water in that hand.
Rotate your arm up and out without lifting your elbow, hold for a moment at the top and lower slowly.
rotacion-externa-isometrica-toalla-pared: Isometric external rotation against the wall
Stand side-on next to a wall, with the elbow on that side tucked into your side and bent at 90 degrees.
Place a folded towel between the back of your hand and wrist and the wall.
Push the back of your hand and wrist into the towel as hard as is comfortable and hold for about 5 seconds.
Relax your hand and wrist and return to the starting position.
rotacion-interna-isometrica-toalla-pared: Isometric internal rotation in a corner
Stand at a corner of a wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides, and bend the elbow on the wall side to 90 degrees.
Place a folded towel between your palm and wrist and the wall.
Push your hand and wrist against the wall to squeeze the towel, as hard as is comfortable, and hold for about 5 seconds.
Relax your hand and wrist and return to the starting position.
barrido-circular-brazo-pared: Circular arm sweep beside a wall
Stand side-on close to a wall, with one foot forward.
With the arm nearest the wall, draw a wide circle with your hand, following the wall without leaning on it.
Make the circles in one direction and then in the other.
To challenge your stability more, do it with one knee on the floor and your feet in line.
circulos-codos-manos-hombros: Elbow circles with hands on the shoulders
Place your hands on your shoulders.
Make circles with your elbows, first forward and then backwards.
deslizamiento-antebrazos-pared: Standing facing a wall, rest your forearms on it at shoulder height, with your fingers pointing up.
Slide your forearms up towards the ceiling while pressing them gently into the wall.
Slide them back down to the starting position.
elevacion-frontal-alterna-bolsas: Stand with your hips and knees slightly bent, holding in each hand a bag with water bottles inside.
Tighten your abs and lower back to stabilise your spine.
Raise one arm in front of you and then the other, alternating, and lower them under control. Use a weight you can lift without straining and no heavier than 6 kg.
elevacion-frontal-botellas: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a bottle or a tin in each hand with your arms straight at your sides and your palms facing backwards.
Keeping your arms straight, breathe out as you raise them in front of you to shoulder height.
Hold for a moment and breathe in as you lower them slowly.
You can also raise your arms one at a time, alternating; if you find it easy, use more weight.
elevacion-frontal-mochila: Stand holding the loaded backpack with both hands in front of your thighs, with your palms facing them.
Brace your torso by tightening your abs.
Slowly raise the backpack in front of your body and lower it gently to the starting position.
elevacion-lateral-codos-doblados-botella: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent, and bend your elbows to a right angle at hip height, with a bottle in each hand and your palms facing in.
Slowly raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, without straightening your elbows.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed; if you shrug them towards your ears, use less weight. Lower slowly.
elevacion-lateral-una-mano-bolsa: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, holding in one hand a bag with some weight inside, such as water bottles.
Raise that arm out to the side, with your elbow straight.
Lower it slowly and under control, then do the other arm. Do not go over 6 kg.
elevaciones-laterales-botellas: Stand upright with your arms at your sides, holding a water bottle in each hand.
With your elbows straight, raise your arms out to the sides until your wrists reach shoulder height.
Lower them slowly and under control. Use a weight that offers resistance but is not too hard to lift.
estiramiento-durmiente-de-pie-pared: Standing sleeper stretch against a wall
Stand with your side against a wall and the shoulder and arm on that side against it, with your elbow bent and your forearm parallel to the floor.
With your other hand, slowly push your forearm down towards the floor until you feel the stretch.
Release and guide your arm back to the starting position.
estiramiento-hombros-pared-brazos-en-cru: Lean your back against a wall, with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows so that your fingertips point at the ceiling and touch the wall behind you; stop when you feel a stretch and hold for 10 to 30 seconds.
Slowly let your arms roll forward, without straightening your elbows, until your fingers point at the floor and, if you can, touch the wall; hold again for 10 to 30 seconds.
Alternate between the two positions; stop immediately if you feel a sharp pain.
extension-isometrica-hombro-pared: Isometric shoulder extension against a wall
Stand with your back to a wall, with your elbow bent at a right angle and tucked into your side.
Try to push the wall backwards with your elbow, gradually increasing the tension in your arm.
Hold the push for 20 to 30 seconds and relax.
letras-t-l-brazos: Open your arms out to the sides to form a T, with your thumbs pointing back and your other fingers together.
Then form an L: elbows bent and tucked into your body, with your thumbs pointing back.
Hold each position for 20 seconds, without bouncing and without arching your back.
marcha-dedos-movilidad-hombros: Finger walk up an imaginary wall
Standing, or sitting on the edge of a chair with your feet on the floor, imagine there is a wall right in front of you.
Slowly walk your fingers up that wall until your arms are above your head; hold for about 10 seconds, moving your fingers, and bring them down just as slowly.
Then try to touch your hands together behind your back: if you can, reach for the opposite elbow with each hand, or get as close as possible.
ochos-brazo-tumbado: Lying figures of eight with arm pointing at the ceiling
Lie on your back and raise one arm straight up towards the ceiling.
With your hand, draw sideways figures of eight in the air, making them bigger each time.
Do it with one arm and then the other; when it feels easy, hold a small bottle of water.
press-dos-manos-bolsa-garrafa: Two-handed overhead press with a large water bottle
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, hold a large water bottle against your chest with both hands; use a small one and make sure it is tightly closed.
Tuck your pelvis in slightly so that you feel your abs engage, and hold that position.
Press the weight towards the ceiling by straightening your elbows.
Bend your elbows to lower it back down to your chest.
press-hombro-una-mano-botella: Standing single-arm shoulder press with a bottle
Standing with your back straight, hold a tin or a bottle of water at shoulder height, with your elbow bent.
Lower it back down to your shoulder. Work one arm at a time and do not go above 6 kg.
press-hombros-botellas: Standing or sitting on a chair, with your feet shoulder-width apart, hold a full bottle of water in each hand.
Raise your hands, with your palms and forearms facing forward, until the bottles are at shoulder height.
Slowly press the bottles overhead until your arms are straight, without locking your elbows.
Pause and lower them slowly to your shoulders, bringing your elbows close to your sides.
rotacion-hombros-tumbado: Lying shoulder rotation with elbows bent
Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight; if your back bothers you, put a rolled-up towel under your knees.
Open your arms out to the sides and bend your elbows so that your hands point at the ceiling; your shoulders and arms stay on the floor the whole time.
Slowly let your forearms drop back until you feel a stretch, stopping before any twinge or sharp pain, and hold for 15 to 60 seconds.
Point at the ceiling again and slowly let your forearms drop forward, towards your hips, until you feel a stretch, and hold.
subir-manos-por-la-pared: Walking the hands up the wall
Stand facing a wall, slightly further than an arm’s length away, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lean forward and place your palms on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart.
With your back straight, slowly walk your hands up the wall until your arms are above your head, and hold for 10 to 30 seconds.
Walk your hands slowly back down in the same way.
apoyo-escapular-mano-adelantada: All-fours hold with one hand forward and arms turned in
Get on all fours, with your knees below your hips, your hands below your shoulders and your back neutral, with your abs firm.
Move your right hand about 15 to 30 cm forward of your shoulder and turn both arms inwards, with your fingertips pointing towards the centre.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds and repeat with the other hand forward.
perro-boca-abajo: Get on all fours with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Spread your fingers wide, press your hands firmly into the floor, tuck your toes under and lift your hips up and back.
Lengthen your back rather than rounding it, with your head and neck relaxed, and try to lower your heels towards the floor; if you prefer, bend your knees slightly.
Hold the position for 10 to 15 seconds.
perro-boca-abajo-desde-plancha: Get into a high plank, with your shoulders directly above your hands and your torso firm, without arching your lower back.
As you breathe out, take your hips back and up with your arms and legs straight, gradually bring your head between your shoulders and try to take your heels towards the floor.
Keep going until your body forms an inverted V with your back flat; if you need to, bend your knees slightly.
As you breathe in, return to the plank, keeping your body aligned.
press-hombros-mochila: Standing shoulder press with a backpack
Put a little weight in a backpack and hold it with both hands at shoulder height.
Standing with your back straight and upright, press it straight up overhead.
Lower it slowly to your shoulders.
press-hombros-rotacion-botellas: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a bottle of water in each hand in front of your shoulders, with your palms facing each other.
With your back straight, turn your torso to the right and, at the end of the turn, press the right-hand bottle up.
Lower it, bringing your elbow down, turn to the left with your back straight and press the left-hand bottle up.
For this shoulder exercise, do not use very heavy bottles.
apoyo-escapular-plancha-hombro-abajo: High plank with one hand forward and shoulder drop
Get into a high plank, with your arms straight, your back flat and your lower back not sagging.
Move your right hand about 15 to 30 cm forward of your shoulder.
Let your left shoulder drop towards the floor and hold for 5 to 10 seconds; then repeat with the other hand forward.
letras-y-w-candelabro: Form a Y with your arms stretched upwards, turning your thumbs back and keeping your other fingers together.
Then form a W: elbows bent and tucked into your body and forearms pointing up, again with your thumbs pointing back.
Hold each position for 20 seconds without arching your back.
rotacion-externa-hombro-bufanda: External rotation with a band held in both hands
With your elbows tucked into your body and bent at 90 degrees, hold one end of a scarf or a resistance band in one hand and the other end in your other hand.
Pull outwards with one hand, without lifting your elbow away from your body, while your other hand resists.
Return to the starting position and, when you finish, change arms.
elevaciones-laterales-sentado-banco-parq: Bottle lateral raise on a park bench
Sit on a park bench with your back straight, your feet on the ground and your knees bent at a right angle, with a full bottle in each hand.
With a firm grip and your palms facing your body, brace your torso by tightening your abs.
Slowly raise the bottles out to the sides until your arms are at shoulder height, and lower them gently to the starting position.
pedaleo-brazos-biosaludable: Seated arm cycling on the outdoor gym machine
Sit up properly and grip the hand pedals.
Turn them in a circle by pushing and pulling, forward or back.
Move them slowly, at a comfortable pace, and stop if your shoulders hurt.
rueda-fuerza-biosaludable: Strength wheel turn with straight arms
Standing facing the wheel, grip it with your arms straight.
Turn it at least 45 degrees to the right and then to the left, without bending your arms.
If it is a double machine, you can do it with another person opposite you, each of you turning your own wheel against the other’s.
rueda-hombro-una-mano-biosaludable: Single-arm shoulder circles on the large wheel
Stand facing the wheel and grip the knob with one hand.
Make circles following the movement of the wheel, in both directions and in a controlled way.
Then change arms; stop if your shoulder hurts.
pajaros-sentado-banco-parque-botellas: Seated rear delt fly on a park bench with bottles
Sit on the edge of a park bench with your feet on the ground and a full bottle in each hand.
Lean forward, with your chest on your thighs if your flexibility allows, and let your arms hang straight below your legs.
With your back flat and your elbows slightly bent, slowly raise your arms out to the sides until your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
press-hombros-sentado-banco-parque-botel: Seated shoulder press on a park bench with bottles
Sit on a park bench with your back against the backrest and hold a full bottle in each hand, at the sides of your head, with your palms facing forward.
Press both bottles overhead at the same time until your elbows are straight.
Lower them slowly and under control by bending your elbows.
press-hombros-sentado-banco-parque-mochi: Seated shoulder press on a park bench with a backpack
Sit on a park bench with your back straight and hold the loaded backpack with both hands in front of your shoulders, at chin height.
Put your feet flat on the ground, tighten your abs and, with your elbows pointing forward, press the backpack straight up overhead.
Lower it slowly to chin height and repeat.
curl-banda-sentado-silla: Seated band biceps curl with the band underfoot
Sit on a chair, step on the middle of a resistance band with both feet and hold the ends with your arms straight.
Bend your arms towards your shoulders with your wrists firm, without moving your elbows away from your torso.
Straighten your arms again. Choose a band that allows you to do the exercise correctly.
curl-biceps-sentado-silla-botellas: Seated bottle biceps curl on a chair
Sit upright on a sturdy chair, without leaning on the back of the chair, with your feet on the floor and a tin or a small water bottle in each hand.
With your arms at your sides and your elbows tucked into your body, bend your elbows to bring the bottles towards your shoulders.
Return slowly to the starting position.
curl-concentrado-botella-silla: Bottle concentration curl seated on a chair
Sit on a chair with your legs apart and a water bottle in one hand, hanging between your legs.
Rest the back of your arm against the inside of your thigh on the same side.
With your palm facing forward, curl the bottle towards your shoulder without lifting your arm off your thigh and lower it slowly.
estiramiento-brazos-respaldo-silla: Arm stretch holding the back of the chair
Sit on a chair, away from the back of the chair, with your arms hanging at your sides.
Take your arms back and try to grab the back of the chair.
From there, push your chest forward until you feel some tension in your arms and hold for 10 seconds; relax without letting go of the back of the chair.
curl-alterno-garrafas: Stand holding a large water bottle or a full plastic bottle in each hand, with your palms facing up and your elbows close to your body.
Slowly curl the weight up with one arm by bending your elbow, keeping your wrist straight and firm.
Lower it slowly and do the same with the other arm, alternating.
curl-biceps-botellas: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a full water bottle in each hand.
With your arms tucked into your sides, slowly bend your elbows until the bottles reach your shoulders.
curl-biceps-mochila: Fill a backpack or a sports bag with sand or books and grip it with both hands, with your palms facing up and shoulder-width apart.
Curl the backpack towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Lower it slowly, keeping your chest still and moving only your arms.
curl-garrafa-dos-manos: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a large water bottle filled with water or sand in both hands in front of your body, with the cap screwed on tightly.
Tuck your pelvis under slightly to engage your abs.
Bend your elbows to raise the large water bottle slowly to your chest, with your palms facing the ceiling.
Lower it slowly, straightening your elbows, back to the starting position.
curl-martillo-alterno-botellas: Stand with one foot slightly forward, holding a bottle in each hand beside your thighs, with your palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle towards the front of your shoulder without turning your wrist, while the other arm stays down.
Lower it slowly until your elbow is straight and repeat with the other arm.
curl-martillo-botellas: Stand with one foot slightly forward, holding a bottle in each hand beside your thighs, with your palms facing your body and your arms straight.
With your abs firm and your shoulders down and back, bend your elbows until the bottles come close to the front of your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight, without bringing your elbows forward or shrugging your shoulders, and lower slowly until your arms are straight.
curl-press-latas: Stand holding a tin or a bottle in each hand at your sides, with your palms facing forward.
Bend your elbows, keeping them tucked into your body, to raise the tins; when they reach head height, open your elbows out to the sides, with your arms at right angles and the tins at eye level.
Straighten your arms to raise the tins above your head, bringing their edges together.
Reverse the movement until the tins are back at the sides of your hips.
curl-arrastre-botellas: Stand holding a water bottle in each hand at your sides, with your palms facing forward.
Draw your elbows back and raise the bottles up to chest height, letting them brush against your torso.
Pause at the top and lower them slowly along the same path.
curl-invertido-botellas: Stand holding a water bottle in each hand with your palms facing down and your arms straight.
With your elbows down and tucked into your sides, curl the bottles towards your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Lower them slowly to the starting position.
curl-martillo-cruzado-botellas: Stand holding a water bottle in each hand with your arms at your sides and your palms facing in.
Curl one bottle towards the opposite shoulder, bringing your arm across the front of your torso, and lower it.
Repeat with the other arm towards the other shoulder.
curl-zottman-botellas: Stand holding a water bottle in each hand at your sides, with your palms facing forward.
With your arms close to your body, curl both bottles towards your shoulders.
At the top, pause, turn your palms to face down and lower the bottles to your sides.
At the bottom, pause again and turn your palms to face forward again.
curl-concentrado-garrafa-banco-parque: Large water bottle concentration curl seated on a park bench
Sit on a park bench with a large water bottle of the smaller kind, or a full bottle, in one hand, hanging between your legs.
Rest the back of that arm against the inside of your thigh on the same side.
With your palm facing forward, curl the weight towards your shoulder and lower it slowly, without lifting your arm off your thigh.
curl-sentado-botellas-banco-parque: Seated bottle biceps curl on a park bench
Sit on a park bench with a backrest, with your back against it and a full bottle in each hand.
Slowly bend both elbows at the same time, bringing the bottles towards your chest without arching your back.
Lower them gently to the starting position.
fondos-silla: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair without wheels, ideally placed against the wall, with your palms on the edge of the seat beside your hips.
With your feet slightly forward and your knees bent at a right angle, straighten your arms to lift your hips off the chair.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, lowering your body towards the floor, and push back up without sitting down again.
fondos-silla-reposabrazos: Sit on a sturdy chair with armrests, with your feet flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, and lean forward slightly with your back and shoulders straight.
Grip the armrests with your hands at your sides and, as you breathe out, push with your arms to slowly lift your body off the chair, until they are almost straight.
Hold for a moment and lower yourself slowly back onto the chair as you breathe in.
Even if you cannot lift yourself off the seat at first, the pushing itself will strengthen your arms.
patada-triceps-sentado-silla-botellas: Seated triceps kickback on a chair with bottles
Sit upright on a backless chair, with your feet flat on the floor hip-width apart and a light bottle in each hand.
Take your arms back with your elbows bent at a right angle, tucked in and parallel to each other, and your palms facing your body.
Slowly straighten your elbows until your arms point straight back, without moving your upper arms, and hold for a moment.
Bend your elbows carefully to return.
extension-triceps-botella-una-mano: Standing or sitting on a sturdy chair without armrests, hold a bottle or a tin in one hand, with your palm facing in, and raise that arm towards the ceiling.
Support that arm below the elbow with your other hand.
Slowly bend your elbow to bring the bottle towards your shoulder and straighten your arm above your head again without locking your elbow.
extension-triceps-dos-manos-botella: Hold a single full bottle or a tin with both hands.
Lift it up and take it just behind your head.
With your elbows close to your ears, straighten your arms above your head.
Lower the weight until your elbows are at a right angle and straighten them again.
patada-triceps-botella: With a bottle of water in one hand, step the opposite leg forward, rest your other hand on your front thigh or knee and lean your torso forward.
Keep the upper arm holding the bottle tucked into your torso, parallel to it, with your elbow bent and your forearm hanging vertically.
Straighten your elbow fully without moving your upper arm and return slowly, without arching or twisting your back.
patada-triceps-dos-botellas: Bent-over triceps kickback with two bottles
Hold a bottle of water in each hand, bend at the hips and lean your torso forward with your back straight and your abs firm.
Bring your elbows behind your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
With your arms held still in that position, straighten and bend your elbows to work your triceps.
talon-gluteo-extension-brazos-botellas: Heel to glute with arm extension, using bottles
Standing with a bottle of water in each hand, bend your arms with your elbows high and close to your head.
Bring one heel up to your glute while you straighten both arms above your head, leaning slightly towards your standing leg.
Come back and alternate legs, with your torso straight and your abs tight so that your lower back does not arch.
extension-triceps-sentado-banco-parque-b: Overhead bottle triceps extension on a park bench
Sit on a park bench with your back straight and your feet on the ground, and hold a full bottle of water with both hands.
Raise it above your head by straightening your elbows until your arms are vertical.
Let the weight slowly bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head; then straighten them again.
extension-triceps-asas-biosaludable: Leaning triceps extension on the machine handles
Grip the handles with your palms facing down and your elbows fully bent, with your legs back and your body leaning towards the handles.
Push through your palms, straightening your elbows until your body is straight and firm.
Lower yourself back to the starting position.
apretar-toalla-enrollada-mesa: Rolled towel squeeze with the forearm on a table
Sit on a chair facing a table, rest your elbow and forearm on it with your palm facing down and hold a rolled-up towel.
Close your hand to squeeze the towel as hard as you can, then relax your hand.
To change the difficulty, use a thicker or thinner towel, so that your grip is more open or more closed.
cubo-arroz-hundir-y-agarrar: Fill a bucket with rice or sand and push your hand in, trying to reach the bottom.
With your hand inside, grab the rice and keep passing it through your hand so that it drops out of the side.
curl-muneca-botella-mesa: Bottle wrist curl on a table
Rest your forearm on a table with your palm facing up, your wrist beyond the edge and a small bottle or a tin in your hand.
Let your hand drop slowly towards the floor, without letting go of the weight or moving your arm.
Bend your wrist to raise the bottle again, keeping your forearm still on the table.
curl-muneca-inverso-lata-mesa: Tin reverse wrist curl on a table
Rest your forearm on a table with your palm facing down and hold a light weight beyond the edge, such as a tin in a bag.
Let your wrist bend slowly towards the floor, without letting go of the weight or moving your arm.
Raise your hand by extending your wrist, slowly and under control.
desviacion-radial-cubital-botella-mesa: Radial and ulnar deviation with a bottle on a table
Rest your forearm on its side on a table, with your thumb up, your wrist beyond the edge and a small bottle or a tin in your hand.
Tilt your hand down towards the floor and then up towards the ceiling, without lifting your forearm off the table.
escurrir-toalla: Hold a rolled-up towel with both hands about 30 centimetres apart, with your palms facing the floor.
Twist the towel by turning one hand down and towards the opposite side while the other turns slightly up and outwards, as if wringing it out.
Untwist the towel to return to the starting position.
Now twist it in the opposite direction, changing your grip if you need to so that you can twist it properly.
flexoextension-muneca-mesa: Wrist flexion and extension with the forearm on a table
Sit on a chair with your forearm resting on a table and your wrist and hand beyond the edge.
Bend your wrist to take your hand down towards the floor and hold the position.
Return to the centre, bend your wrist to bring your hand up towards the ceiling and hold.
Relax and return to the starting position.
pronacion-supinacion-botella-mesa: Pronation and supination with a bottle on a table
Rest your forearm on its side on a table, with your wrist beyond the edge and a small bottle in your hand.
Rotate your forearm slowly until your palm faces up and pause.
Then rotate it until your palm faces down, with your forearm supported.
cubo-arroz-muneca-giros-dedos: Rice bucket: wrist, twists and fingers
With your hand in a fist, push it into a bucket full of rice while bending and straightening your wrist.
Repeat the movement with your hand open.
With your hand in the rice, turn it inwards and outwards, and spread your fingers forcefully.
Do the movements one after another, then repeat them with the other hand.
abrir-cerrar-manos: Open your hands and spread your fingers.
circulos-munecas-dedos-entrelazados: Interlace the fingers of both hands; if you cannot, simply cross your hands.
Make circles with your wrists in one direction and then in the other, outwards and inwards.
estiramiento-antebrazos-rodillas-manos-s: Kneel with your arms straight and your hands on the floor, with your wrists rotated.
Shift your body back until you feel the stretch on the inner side of your forearms.
estiramiento-oracion-invertida: Put the backs of your hands and fingers together in front of your waist, with your fingers pointing at the floor.
Raise your hands towards the ceiling, so that your elbows move apart and your fingers keep pointing at the floor.
Hold the stretch and lower your hands to the starting position.
flexoextension-muneca-botellas: Wrist flexion and extension with small bottles
Hold a small water bottle in each hand, with your arms at your sides, your elbows bent and your palms facing down.
Moving only your wrists, raise the bottles until you feel a gentle stretch on the inner side and hold for a few moments.
Lower the bottles until you feel the stretch on the outer side of your wrist and hold again.
paseo-granjero-bolsas: Put the same weight into two shopping bags, for example bottles or tins, and pick one up in each hand with a firm grip.
With your arms at your sides and your back straight, walk the distance you have set.
When you get there, turn around and walk back to the starting point.
paseo-granjero-garrafas: Farmer’s walk with large water bottles
Pick up a full large water bottle in each hand with a firm grip and let your arms hang at your sides, with the bottles beside your hips.
With your back straight, walk the distance you have set.
When you get there, turn around and walk back to the starting point.
rotaciones-muneca: Wrist rotations with elbow tucked in (palm up and down)
Stand with your elbow bent at a right angle and tucked into your side, your hand open and your thumb pointing up.
Turn your hand until your palm faces up and hold the position, with your elbow close to your body.
Come back to thumb up, now turn your palm towards the floor and hold; when you finish, change hands.
tiron-dedos-enganchados: Isometric pull with fingers hooked together
Sit on a chair or stand with your back upright and hook the fingers of one hand into those of the other in front of your chest.
Try to pull your hands apart, pulling outwards and using the strength of your fingers so that they do not let go.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and down while you pull.
curl-muneca-botellas-banco-parque: Bottle wrist curl on a park bench
Kneel beside a park bench with a full bottle in each hand and rest your elbows on the seat, bent at roughly a right angle.
Turn your forearms so that your palms face up, with the bottles hanging beyond the edge and your wrists straight.
Let your wrists bend slowly towards the ground and raise the bottles again by tightening your forearm muscles.
curl-muneca-inverso-botellas-banco-parqu: Bottle reverse wrist curl on a park bench
Kneel beside a park bench with a full bottle in each hand and rest your elbows on the seat.
Turn your forearms so that your palms face down, with the underside of your forearms on the seat and your wrists straight.
Let your wrists bend slowly towards the ground and raise the bottles again by tightening the muscles on the top of your forearms.
molinillo-munecas-biosaludable: Wrist roller: turn the bar forward and back
Grip the rotating bar by its tube.
Turn it forward and back in a controlled way, moving your wrists, elbows and shoulders.
pronacion-supinacion-botellas-banco-parq: Pronation and supination with bottles on a park bench
Kneel beside a park bench with a full bottle in each hand and rest your elbows on the seat, bent at roughly a right angle, with the bottles beyond the edge.
With your wrists straight, slowly rotate your forearms to bring the bottles towards the ground.
Rotate them slowly the other way, upwards, hold for a moment and repeat, without loosening your grip or jerking.
alcance-frontal-sentado: Seated forward reach with raised arms
Sit on a chair and raise your arms in front of you to horizontal, with your palms facing each other.
Lean your torso forward as far as you can, taking your back away from the back of the chair and without lowering your arms.
Sit back against the back of the chair and repeat.
caida-tronco-entre-rodillas: Back stretch with the torso between the knees
Sit on a chair and move your knees apart.
Let your head, torso and arms drop between your knees; you can also lean forward and hold the backs of your knees.
Hold for about 30 seconds and return to the starting position.
equilibrio-ojos-cerrados: Stand next to a firm surface, such as the worktop, with your hand close to it but not resting on it.
Place your feet apart, close your eyes and keep your balance without holding on for 1 minute.
If you can, increase the time slightly each time.
escalador-encimera: Mountain climber with hands on the worktop
Get into position as for a worktop press-up: both hands on the edge and your arms straight.
Bend one knee and bring it towards your chest.
Straighten your leg to return to the starting position and do the same with the other knee, alternating.
estiramiento-espalda-sentado-flexion: Sit towards the front of a sturdy chair without armrests, with your feet flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Slowly lean forward from your hips, keeping your back and neck straight.
Relax your neck, drop your chin and keep lowering yourself as you slide your hands down your legs towards your shins; stop when you feel a stretch and hold for 10 to 30 seconds.
Slowly sit back up to the starting position.
inclinacion-atras-sentado-silla: Seated backward lean on a chair
Sit on a chair, keeping your feet on the floor at all times.
Lean your body back, keeping your back straight, and hold the position.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
inclinacion-lateral-sentado-silla: Seated side bend on a chair, touching the floor
Sitting on a chair, lean your torso to one side until the hand on that side touches the floor.
escalador-deslizando-toallas: On a wooden floor, put your feet together on two folded towels and get into a high plank, with your abs and upper body engaged.
Slide your right knee towards your right elbow.
Return to the centre and slide your left knee towards your left elbow.
pica-deslizando-toallas: Pike with feet sliding on towels
On a wooden floor, put your feet on two folded towels, hip-width apart, and get into a forearm plank.
Engage your abs and upper body.
As you breathe out, raise your hips towards the ceiling with your legs straight and your eyes on your feet.
As you breathe in, lower slowly into the plank and hold it for a few seconds.
plancha-antebrazos-deslizando-brazos: Forearm plank with arm slides on towels
On a wooden floor, get into a plank with your forearms on two folded towels and your feet apart, to give yourself a wide base and keep your pelvis stable.
Slide one arm forward and back, and then the other, alternating.
You can also slide your arms in circles, in one direction and then in the other.
plancha-arana-deslizando-toallas: Spider plank with feet sliding on towels
On a wooden floor, put your feet together on two folded towels and get into a forearm plank, with your abs and upper body engaged.
Bring each knee towards the elbow on the same side at the same time, letting your hips rise; your knees do not actually touch your elbows.
Return to the plank and keep repeating the movement.
acercar-alejar-botella-de-pie: Standing, hold a one-kilo weight, such as a full bottle, in both hands at chest height.
Move the weight away from your body by straightening your arms and bring it back in, without letting it drop below chest height.
bascula-pelvica-tumbado: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Relax your abs to arch your lower back, lifting it off the floor.
Then tighten your abs and glutes to flatten your lower back against the floor.
Relax and return to the starting position.
circulos-cadera-de-pie: Stand up and, if you need to, hold on to a worktop or the back of a chair with both hands.
Without moving your shoulders or feet, draw a large circle to the left with your hips.
Then make the same circles to the right.
crunch-isometrico-pies-pared: Isometric crunch with feet on the wall
Lie on your back next to a wall and place your feet on it, with your knees and hips bent at right angles.
Cross your arms over your chest, tighten your abs and lift your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold for three deep breaths and lower back down.
desplazamiento-lateral-tronco: Lateral torso shift with arms out to the sides
With your arms open out to the sides at shoulder height, shift your shoulders to one side and hold.
Then stretch to the other side and hold, without bouncing.
elevacion-rodilla-de-pie: Slow standing knee raise without support
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, looking straight ahead.
Slowly raise one knee as high as you can, while still looking straight ahead.
Lower it gradually and repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-puntillas-brazos-arriba: Standing, reach your arms and hands as high as you can towards the ceiling.
Rise onto your tiptoes and hold for about 5 seconds.
extension-tronco-de-pie: Standing torso extension with hands on the back
Stand with your legs apart and place your hands on the back of your hips.
Slowly lean your torso back, pushing your waist forward, until you feel the stretch.
Hold for about 15 seconds and return to the starting position.
extension-y-flexion-en-plancha: Plank with hips down and hips up
Get into a high plank with your arms straight.
Let your body drop towards the floor, sagging through the middle without bending your arms and looking ahead, until you feel the stretch in your hips and abdomen; hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the plank, shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise your hips; straighten your legs, try to lower your heels and tuck your head between your arms with your back straight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and return to the plank.
flexion-y-alcance: Bend and reach between the legs
Stand with your legs apart and your arms stretched above your head.
Lower into a partial squat without lifting your heels, round your back and reach your arms as far back as possible between your legs, tucking your chin in.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
inclinacion-lateral-brazo-arriba: Standing side bend with one arm overhead
Stand with your feet a comfortable distance apart and your hands at your sides.
Slide one hand down your leg towards your knee, so that your shoulder tilts to that side and down towards the floor.
At the same time, reach your other arm up towards the ceiling and then over your head, towards the side you are leaning to.
Return to the starting position and repeat to the other side.
inclinacion-lateral-de-pie: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one arm down your side as far as is comfortable; as you lower it, you will feel the stretch in the hip on the other side.
Hold for 2 seconds, come back up and repeat with the other arm.
lenador-sin-peso: Stand with your arms out in front, your palms together and your hips facing forward.
With your arms straight, rotate your upper body and take your arms down to one side.
Then raise them diagonally all the way up towards the opposite side, without turning your hips.
molino-de-pie: Standing windmill (twist and opposite foot touch)
Stand with your legs apart and your arms straight out to the sides.
Bend your hips and knees as you turn your torso to the left and touch the outside of your left foot with your right hand, looking behind you; your left arm goes back.
Return to the starting position and repeat to the other side.
paseo-maleta-bolsa: Suitcase carry with a shopping bag
Fill a bag with shopping, for example tins and a litre of milk, and hold it in one hand.
Standing upright with your body centred, walk to one end of the room and back.
Repeat with the bag in the other hand; to make it harder, add things to the bag on the next lap.
paseo-maleta-garrafa: Suitcase carry with a large water bottle
Hold a full large water bottle firmly in one hand only, with your arm straight beside your body and the bottle next to your hip.
With your back straight, walk the distance you have set, turn around and walk back to the starting point.
Change the bottle to the other hand and repeat the walk.
plancha-lateral-pared: Standing side plank against the wall
Stand side-on next to a wall and rest your forearm against it at shoulder height.
Move your feet away from the wall as you put more weight on your forearm.
Tighten your abs and hold the position for as long as is comfortable.
Bring your feet closer to the wall to return to the starting position.
plancha-rodillas-presion: Kneeling plank with elbow and knee squeeze
Lie face down and lift yourself up onto your forearms and knees, with your shoulders directly above your elbows and your head and neck in line with your back.
Tighten your abs and push as if you wanted to bring your elbows and knees together, without letting them move from where they are.
Hold for three deep breaths and lower yourself back down.
prensa-abdominal-rodilla-hacia-fuera: Lying hand press on the outside of the knee
Lie on your back with your knees bent, your back neutral and your abs tight, and raise one leg with your hip and knee at right angles.
Place the hand on the same side on the outside of your knee and push it inwards while your knee pushes outwards, without moving.
Hold for three deep breaths and change sides.
prensa-abdominal-una-pierna: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your back neutral, neither arched nor pressed flat against the floor, and tighten your abs.
Raise one leg until your hip and knee form right angles and rest the hand on the same side on top of that knee.
Push your knee with your hand while you use your abs to push your knee into your hand, with your arm straight; hold for three deep breaths and change sides.
rotacion-de-pie-brazos-largos: Standing, take your right foot a step back and rest it on the ball of the foot.
Raise your right arm, with your elbow slightly bent, and stretch your left arm down with your fingers pointing at the floor.
Rotate your torso towards the inside of your left thigh, lengthening your arms, as if your hands were trying to reach higher and lower; return to the centre, repeat and change sides.
rotacion-tronco-de-pie: Standing torso rotation with arms crossed
Standing upright, cross your arms over your chest.
Turn from the waist to bring your chest round to one side, without moving your feet.
Return to the centre and repeat to the other side.
torsion-tumbado-una-rodilla: Lying back twist with one knee crossed over
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Using your hand, bring one knee across your body towards the floor, twisting your back.
Stretch your other arm out to the side and keep your upper back on the floor while you straighten your other leg.
escalador: Get into a high plank with your left foot under your chest and your left knee between your arms.
Put your weight on your hands and switch the position of your feet: bring your right foot forward and take your left foot back.
Keep alternating with your back straight, without letting your hips rise or drop.
giro-piernas-flexionadas-tumbado: Lying bent-leg twist in the air
Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides and your palms on the floor, and lift your legs with your hips and knees bent at right angles, knees and feet together.
Rotate your legs together to the left, lowering them towards the floor, without lifting your upper back or arms off the floor.
Return to the centre and repeat to the right.
plancha-arcoiris: Rainbow plank (hip twist to the floor)
Get into a forearm plank, with your back straight and your elbows below your shoulders.
Rotate your hips to one side, trying to touch the floor with them.
Then rotate to the other side until you touch the floor and keep alternating.
plancha-cadera-arriba-v-invertida: Plank with hip raise into an inverted V
Get into a forearm plank, with your back straight and your elbows below your shoulders.
Raise your hips until you form an inverted V, keeping your muscles engaged.
From the highest point, lower back into the plank and repeat.
plancha-rodilla-codo-contrario: High plank with knee to opposite elbow
Get into a high plank, with your arms straight.
Bring your left knee across under your body, trying to touch your right elbow.
Return to the plank and do the same with your right knee towards your left elbow, alternating with your whole body engaged.
plancha-rodillas-brazo-pierna: Kneeling plank with arm or leg raise
Support yourself on your forearms and knees, with your shoulders above your elbows, your head in line with your back and your abs tight.
Lift one arm off the floor and hold for three deep breaths; repeat with the other arm and then with each leg.
To make it harder, lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
plancha-subida-cadera-rapida: Plank with hip drop and quick hip lift
Get into a high plank with your elbows fully straight.
Without bending your elbows, lower your hips towards the floor and bring them up quickly into the hip-flexed position.
Repeat the down-and-up hip movement, keeping your arms straight.
prensa-abdominal-cruzada: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your back neutral and your abs tight.
Raise your left leg with your hip and knee at right angles and rest your right hand on that knee.
Push your knee with your hand while you pull your knee towards your hand, across the centre of your body; hold for three deep breaths and change sides.
prensa-abdominal-dos-piernas: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your back neutral and your abs tight.
Raise your legs one at a time until your hips and knees form right angles and rest your hands on your knees.
Push your knees with your hands while you use your abs to pull them towards your hands, with your arms straight; hold for three deep breaths.
