recogida-piernas-giro-pies-apoyados: Leg tuck with a twist from feet on the floor
Sit leaning back, supported on your hands behind your shoulders, with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lift your legs, pivoting on your left glute, and bring your knees towards your left shoulder, without losing control of your bent knees or your torso.
Return to the starting position and repeat to the right.
remero-tumbado: Lie on your back with your legs straight and together, your arms stretched out above your head with your palms facing in and your head slightly off the floor.
Sit up, bending your hips and knees while you bring your arms forward, parallel to the floor, until you are sitting with your feet flat and your knees between your arms.
Reverse the movement to return to the starting position.
rodilla-al-pecho-saltando-de-lado: Knee to chest, hopping from one foot to the other
Stand with your legs apart and your hands on your waist.
Do a small hop to land on your left foot while you bring your right knee up towards your chest; your right hand goes down towards your right ankle and your left hand touches your right knee.
Hop onto your right foot, bringing your left knee up, with your hands the other way round, and keep alternating.
rotacion-de-pie-brazos-cruzados: Standing rotation with cross-body arm opening
Standing, take your right foot a step back and rest it on the ball of the foot.
Bend both elbows at a right angle: your right hand in front of your chest with the palm facing down and your left with the fingers pointing up and the palm facing forward.
Turn towards the inside of your left thigh and straighten both arms at the same time: your right arm crosses in front of your body and your left arm rises above your head.
Return to the centre, repeat and change sides.
salto-cuarto-de-giro-alterno: Stand with your legs apart in a half squat, with your hands at chest height, facing forward.
Jump up and rotate your hips to turn your legs 90 degrees to the left, without letting your torso turn: your head and chest keep facing forward.
Jump again to return to the starting position, with your feet the same width apart, and repeat to the right.
v-up-rodillas-flexionadas: Lie on your back with your arms on the floor, about 45 degrees out from your body, your knees bent and your feet flat.
Raise your legs, with your knees bent, and your torso at the same time, bringing your knees towards your chest and using your arms for balance.
Return under control to put your feet down with your knees bent, without letting your legs drop.
plancha-lateral-mano-brazo-arriba: Side plank on one hand with arm raised
Lie on your left side and support yourself on your left hand, with your shoulders, hips and knees in a straight line.
Lift your hips off the floor and reach your right hand up.
Hold for three deep breaths and repeat on the other side.
plancha-subida-cadera-pierna-abierta: Plank with quick hip lift and leg out to the side
Get into a high plank with one foot lifted about 20 to 30 cm off the floor and moved out to the side.
With your elbows straight, lower your hips towards the floor and raise them quickly into the hip-flexed position.
Change supporting foot and repeat with the other foot lifted and out to the side.
plancha-subida-cadera-una-pierna: Plank with quick hip lift on one leg
Get into a high plank with one foot lifted about 20 to 30 cm off the floor.
With your elbows straight and your foot in the air, lower your hips towards the floor and raise them quickly into the hip-flexed position.
Change supporting foot and repeat with the other foot lifted.
recogida-piernas-con-giro: Seated leg tuck with a twist
Sit leaning back, supported on your hands behind your shoulders with your palms down, with your legs straight, together and slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs, pivoting on your left glute, and bring your knees towards your left shoulder, keeping control of your legs and torso.
Straighten your legs again without putting your feet down and repeat to the right side.
v-up: Lie on your back with your arms on the floor, about 45 degrees out from your body, your knees bent at a right angle and your head slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs and torso at the same time until you form a V, with your knees straight, using your arms for balance and keeping your head in line with your torso.
Return under control to the starting position, without letting your legs drop.
carrera-brazos-al-frente: Running with arms out in front
Stand on one foot with the other leg tucked up under your hip and your arms straight out in front at shoulder height, with your hands together.
Run like this for a short distance, with your torso upright and without bending at the waist.
Then run the same distance with your arms free.
carrera-manos-a-la-espalda: Running with hands clasped behind the back
Stand on one foot with the other leg tucked up under your hip and your hands clasped behind your back.
Run like this for a short distance: you will notice that your body tends to tip forward, and you will have to resist this by keeping your torso upright.
Then run the same distance moving your arms normally.
elevacion-pierna-respaldo-mantenida-bios: Single-leg raise hold with the back against the backrest
Standing, lean your back against the backrest of the machine with your feet on the ground.
Lift one leg, bent or straight, and hold it while you count to five, tightening your abs.
Lower it and do the same with the other leg.
marcha-rodillas-altas-paralelas-biosalud: High-knee walk between the parallel bars
Stand between the parallel bars and keep looking straight ahead.
Walk, lifting your knees to work on your balance, and hold on to the bars if you need to.
marcha-tandem-viga-biosaludable: Tandem walk on the balance beam
Step onto one end of the beam with one foot in front of the other.
With your arms out to the sides, walk slowly to the other end and back.
Keep your balance by looking straight ahead; if you wobble too much, step off the beam to regain it.
torsion-tronco-biosaludable: Hold on to the machine with your hands.
Slowly turn your torso to one side and then to the other, stopping before you feel any pain.
Do not use this machine if you have instability or back pain.
abdominal-banco-biosaludable: Crunch on the outdoor sit-up bench
Lie on your back on the bench with your lower back supported and your feet hooked under the foot bar.
Bend your knees and place your hands at the sides of your head.
Bend at your hips and waist to lift your torso off the bench, then lower it slowly back to the starting position.
elevacion-piernas-banco-abdominales-bios: Lying leg raise on the outdoor sit-up bench
Lie on the bench the other way round, with your head towards the bar, and hold on to it with your hands.
Engage your abs by pressing your lower back into the bench and straighten your legs.
Raise and lower your straight legs, or your knees instead.
encogimiento-rodillas-borde-banco: Seated knee tuck on the edge of a bench
Sit on the edge of the bench with your legs straight out in front of you, slightly below horizontal.
Lean back until your body is at about 45 degrees and hold on to the sides of the bench.
As you breathe out, bring your torso upright while drawing your knees towards your chest.
Hold for a moment and return to the starting position as you breathe in.
extension-lumbar-biosaludable: Back extension on the outdoor gym machine
Step onto the footplate with your feet hip-width apart, your thighs on the pads and your heels held by the support behind them.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and keep your neck and back straight, with your chin slightly tucked in.
Bend at the hips until you can see the ground and come up slowly, using your back muscles and glutes, until your body is in a straight line, without using momentum.
Pause at the top and lower yourself slowly again.
gateo-spiderman-arena: On the sand, get into a plank at one end of the course and lower your body towards the sand.
At the same time, move your left hand forward and out to the side, and bring your right knee towards your right hand.
Keep your hips low and your abs firm, and keep alternating until you have covered the marked course, there and back.
gusano: Stand with your feet together or slightly apart, brace your abs and bend forward from the hips with your knees almost straight until you can place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Walk your hands forward in small steps, without moving your feet, until you are in a high plank with your back, hips and head in line.
Do a full press-up without letting your lower back sag or your hips rise.
Walk your feet towards your hands in small steps, without moving your hands, and repeat, moving forward a few metres.
estiramiento-aductores-silla-al-reves: Adductor stretch sitting backwards on a chair
Sit backwards on a chair, straddling it with one leg on each side and facing the back of the chair.
Gently use your hands to spread your legs a little further apart.
rodilla-pecho-sentado-silla: Seated knee to chest on a chair
Hold one knee with your hands and bring it as close to your chest as you can, with your other leg touching the floor.
Hold for 30 seconds and change legs.
arrastre-lateral-toalla-elevacion-latera: Lateral towel slide with bottle lateral raise
Standing with a bottle of water in each hand at your sides, place one foot on a small towel on the floor.
Slide that foot out to the side with your leg straight, pressing into the floor and bending your other knee, while you raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Return to the starting position by bringing your leg and arms back in to your body. When you finish, change feet.
deslizamiento-pierna-tres-direcciones-to: Three-way leg slide with a towel
Standing on a smooth floor, put one foot on the floor and the other on a towel.
Slide the foot on the towel forward, out to the side away from your body, and diagonally across the front of your body.
Always return to the starting position before sliding your foot in the next direction.
If you find it difficult, do it without the towel, moving your foot in the same directions.
equilibrio-una-pierna-toalla: Single-leg balance on a folded towel
Stand on one leg on a folded towel or a cushion on the floor.
Try to keep your balance for 10 seconds and repeat with the other leg.
To make it harder, use a thicker towel or cushion; to make it easier, hold on to a chair or another stable surface.
estiramiento-gluteo-de-pie-apoyo: Standing glute stretch with one ankle on the opposite knee
Standing, hold on to a sturdy chair, a handrail or another support.
Place the ankle of one leg on the opposite knee, with the knee of the crossed leg bent and turned out.
Shift your body back until you feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg; hold for 15 to 30 seconds and change legs.
caminar-de-lado: Stand with your feet together and your knees slightly bent.
Take a slow, controlled step to the side with one foot and then bring the other foot in to meet it, without letting your hips drop.
Move like this from one side of the room to the other and come back the other way.
equilibrio-una-pierna-apoyo: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold on to the back of the chair, or face a wall with your arms straight and your fingertips resting on it.
Lift one foot off the floor, keeping your hips level and your other knee slightly bent.
Hold the position for 5 to 10 seconds, put your foot down gently and change legs.
equilibrio-una-pierna-brazos-cruzados: Standing, with a table or a chair nearby in case you need to hold on, cross your arms over your chest.
Bend one leg while the other stays straight and keep that foot raised while you count to 10.
Lower it and repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-aductores-escalon: Standing adductor stretch with one leg on a step
Standing side-on to a step, rest one straight leg on it.
Lean your torso towards that leg until you feel the stretch on the inside of your thigh.
Hold for about 20 seconds and change legs.
estiramiento-banda-iliotibial-de-pie: Standing side hip stretch with legs crossed
Stand next to a wall for support and cross your left leg over your right at the ankles.
Stretch your left arm over your head, reaching towards your right side, until you feel the stretch along your left hip.
Hold for about 30 seconds and change sides.
estiramiento-cadera-rodilla-al-lado: Hip stretch letting one knee drop
Lie on your back with your legs together, your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, and try to keep both shoulders on the floor.
Slowly lower one knee out to the side as far as is comfortable, keeping your feet together and without moving the other leg.
Hold for 10 to 30 seconds, bring the knee back up slowly and repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-gluteo-sentado-pierna-cruza: Seated glute stretch with the crossed leg to the chest
Sit on the floor with one leg straight and cross the foot of your other leg over the straight leg.
Pull the knee and shin of the crossed leg towards your chest to stretch, then repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-ingle-zancada-lateral: Stand with your legs apart and your hands on your hips.
Take a long step to the right and bend your right knee into a side lunge, with your torso and head facing forward.
Hold, or go a little lower, to stretch the inside of your left thigh for 20 to 30 seconds; come back and change sides.
marcha-equilibrio-pausa: Hold your arms out to the sides at shoulder height and fix your eyes on a point in front of you.
Walk in a straight line, placing one foot in front of the other.
With each step, lift your back leg and pause briefly before bringing it forward.
mariposa-tumbado: Lie on your back on the floor, relaxed, with your knees bent and the soles of your feet together.
Press your lower back into the floor and hold for about 6 seconds.
mesa-invertida: Reverse tabletop (face-up hip raise, hands behind)
Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat in front of you, and place your hands on the floor behind you, with your fingers pointing towards your glutes.
Push through your feet and hands to raise your hips until you form a table, with your knees, hips and shoulders in a straight line; use your abs to help you rise a little higher.
paso-atras-elevacion-frontal: Step back with toe tap and front arm raise
Take one leg back and touch the floor with your toes while you raise your arms in front of you.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
paso-cruzado-lateral: Move sideways by crossing one foot in front of the other.
Then bring your other foot alongside to meet it and keep moving.
Take small steps: the shorter they are, the more you work your balance. If you need to, rest your fingers on a wall.
paso-lateral-elevacion-brazos: Side step with lateral arm raise
Take a long step to one side while you raise your arms out to the sides.
Return to the starting position and repeat to the other side.
pendulo-pierna-lateral: Side leg swing on one foot
Stand with your legs apart and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Balancing on your right leg, swing your left leg out to the side.
Bring it back to the starting position, then swing your right leg out to its side and keep alternating.
recogida-pierna-tumbado-de-lado: Lie on your side with your legs straight and keep your top leg slightly raised above your bottom leg.
Bend the hip and knee of that leg until they form a right angle, keeping your leg and foot at the same height throughout the movement.
Straighten it again under control and, when you finish, change sides.
torsion-figura-cuatro-tumbado: Lying twist with one ankle on the opposite knee
Lie on your back with your knees bent, as if to do a crunch, and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently rotate your legs to one side, keeping your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 30 to 60 seconds and change sides.
zancada-botellas: Forward lunge with bottles of water
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a full bottle of water in each hand.
Take a long step forward with one leg and bend both knees to lower yourself, with your back heel raised.
Without letting your front knee go past your foot, return to the starting position.
Finish the reps on one leg and then change to the other.
alcances-una-pierna-reloj: Stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent.
Reach forward with your hand as far as you can, looking where you are reaching, and return to the centre.
Repeat, reaching in different directions, like the hours on a clock face.
equilibrio-estrella: Reach your other leg forward as far as you can and touch the floor gently with your toes.
Return to the centre and repeat in other directions around you, like the hours on a clock face.
giro-y-zancada: Turn and lunge with floor reach
Stand with your legs apart and your hands on your waist.
Turn 90 degrees to the left, pivoting on your right foot, and lunge forward with your left, bringing your right hand to the floor between your legs and your left arm back.
With your head in line with your spine, stand up, turning back to the starting position, and repeat to the right.
marcha-con-alcance-al-pie: Take a step and stay on that leg while you raise your other knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Engage your abs and squeeze the glute of your standing leg.
Then lean forward and reach your opposite arm towards your standing foot; come back up, take a step and repeat with the other leg.
pasar-pie-sobre-botellas: Foot pass over two bottles, front and back
Stand between two small objects on the floor, such as two small bottles, one in front of you and one behind.
Balancing on one leg, move the other over the object in front and then over the one behind.
Repeat the sequence and change feet.
plancha-invertida-antebrazos: Lie on your back with your legs straight and prop yourself up on your forearms.
Push through your heels and forearms to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from your ankles to your shoulders.
Raise your gaze slightly so as not to strain your neck, and do not forget to breathe.
postura-de-la-paloma: Get on all fours and bring one leg forward under your abdomen until your knee and shin rest on the floor, just behind your hands.
Set your bent knee at about 90 degrees, lined up in front of your hip, and slide your other leg straight back, resting your knee and the top of your foot on the floor.
Support yourself on your hands or fingertips while you hold the stretch; to make it more intense, lower your chest towards the floor.
Return to all fours and repeat with the other leg.
rotacion-cadera-90-90: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees and resting on the floor.
Gently raise and lower your front knee several times.
zancada-atras-botellas: Reverse lunge with bottles of water
Standing with a full bottle of water in each hand and your feet hip-width apart, step back with one leg.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee towards the floor, with your torso upright and your front shin vertical.
Straighten your knees to return to standing and repeat, stepping back with the other leg.
zancada-atras-mochila: Reverse lunge with a backpack on the back
Put on a weighted backpack and, if you need to, stand next to a wall or a table for balance.
With your feet hip-width apart, step back and bend both knees, lowering your back knee towards the floor with your torso upright.
Keep your front shin vertical, straighten your knees to come back and alternate legs.
zancada-caminando-brazo-arriba: Lift one knee as if marching and, from that position, lunge forward.
In the lunge, reach the arm opposite your front leg up, with your abs engaged, squeezing the glute of your back leg.
Stand up, move forward and repeat with the other leg along a short stretch.
zancada-caminando-giro: Lift one knee as if marching and lunge forward.
In the lunge, open your arms and turn your torso towards the side of your front leg, without turning your pelvis.
Stand up and keep moving forward, alternating your front leg.
zancada-caminando-mochila: Put on the loaded backpack and stand with your feet hip-width apart in a place with room to move forward.
With your back straight, step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor as far as is comfortable.
Push through your front foot to stand up and keep moving forward with a step of the other leg.
zancada-curl-botellas: Stand with a tin or a full bottle in each hand and your arms at your sides.
Take a long step forward with one leg and, as you lower your hips, raise your hands towards your shoulders with your palms facing up.
Stop just before your back knee touches the floor, come back up and lower your arms slowly to your sides.
zancada-lateral-botellas: Lateral lunge with bottles of water
Stand with your feet slightly apart and a bottle of water in each hand.
Step to one side with your toes pointing forward and lower yourself, pushing your hips back and bending that knee.
Push through your bent leg to return to the centre and repeat to the other side.
zancada-lateral-mochila: Lateral lunge with a backpack on the back
Put on a weighted backpack and stand with your feet slightly apart.
Step to one side with your toes pointing forward and lower yourself, pushing your hips back and bending that knee.
Push through your bent leg to return to the centre and repeat to the other side.
zancada-lateral-rotacion: Standing upright, step out to the side with your left leg and lower into a side lunge.
Bring your right hand towards your left calf, turning your torso slightly towards the inside of your thigh.
Return to the starting position, repeat with the same leg and then change sides.
zancada-mochila: Put on the loaded backpack and bring your feet together.
Take a long step forward and bend both knees to lower your body close to the floor.
Push the floor away with your front foot to bring your feet back together and repeat with the other leg.
zancadas-laterales-encadenadas: Standing side-on to the direction of travel, take a side lunge and sit back into that position, without your knee going past your toes.
Take a small hopping step to reset and repeat the side lunge in the same direction, moving along a short stretch.
la-ciguena-equilibrio: The stork: single-leg balance with arm changes
Stand on one foot and lift the opposite knee, with your gaze fixed on a point at eye level.
Without lowering your foot, open your arms out to the sides, then bring them to your chest and lean your torso towards the side of your standing leg.
Finally, open your arms out to the sides again and close your eyes. Repeat the sequence on the other foot.
plancha-invertida-elevacion-pierna: Reverse forearm plank with leg raise
Get into a reverse forearm plank, with your body in a straight line from your ankles to your shoulders.
Lift one leg off the floor, lower it and then lift the other.
recoger-objeto-una-pierna: Standing upright, with an object on the floor in front of your feet, balance on one leg.
Slowly bend your standing knee, keeping it in line with your second toe.
Reach down to pick up the object while you stretch your other leg out behind you for balance, and stand back up.
abrir-la-puerta-caminando: As you walk, lift one leg by bending your hip and knee.
Take your knee out to the side in a half circle, put your foot down and repeat with the other leg on the next step.
caminar-abrazando-rodilla: As you walk, hold one knee with your hands and pull it towards your chest.
Let go of the leg, put your foot down, take a step and repeat with the other leg, alternating over a short distance.
caminar-cuesta-arriba-paso-potente: On steep slopes, switch from running to a fast, powerful walk, with shorter, quicker steps.
Lean forward slightly from your ankles, not from your waist, and drive each step with your glutes.
If the slope is very steep, you can rest your hands on your lower thighs to help yourself along.
caminar-tobillo-rodilla-al-pecho: Walking ankle and knee to chest
As you walk, hold the ankle and knee of one leg with your hands.
Bring your ankle and knee towards your chest at the same time; let go, take a step and repeat with the other leg.
cerrar-la-puerta-caminando: As you walk, lift one leg with your knee bent, taking it out to the side of your body.
From there, bring your knee inwards across the midline of your body in a half circle; put your foot down and repeat with the other leg.
desplazamiento-lateral: Stand side-on to the direction of travel, with your feet shoulder-width apart, crouching slightly, with your elbows bent at 90 degrees and your palms facing forward.
Take a sideways step with your leading leg and bring the other leg in towards it, with your feet parallel, your toes pointing forward and your weight on the balls of your feet.
Always face the same way: cover a stretch in one direction and come back in the other, with your abs firm. Go faster once you have mastered the movement.
marcha-lateral-paralelas-biosaludable: Lateral walk between the parallel bars
Stand between the parallel bars and keep looking straight ahead.
Walk sideways in one direction and then in the other, moving safely.
rodillas-altas-trote: Jog with short, quick steps, lifting your knees above waist height.
With your knee up, pull your heel and toes up as well.
Swing your arms from the shoulder, with your elbows fixed at a right angle, and move forward slowly over a short stretch.
aceleraciones-en-cuesta: Find a gentle slope and do short accelerations uphill.
Lean from your ankles and shorten your steps, without reaching out with your stride in front of your body.
Recover fully between one acceleration and the next so that each one is clean.
carioca: Stand side-on to the direction of travel, crouching slightly, with your back straight and your arms at your sides.

Move sideways: cross your trailing leg in front of your leading leg; on the next step, bring the leading leg out from behind to uncross them; then cross the trailing leg behind and, on the fourth step, bring the leading leg out in front to uncross them.
Repeat the cycle, lifting your feet and moving on the balls of your feet, with your back straight and your torso perpendicular to the direction of travel.
Increase the speed once you have mastered the movement, and do it in both directions.
carioca-elevacion-rodilla: Side-on to the direction of travel, cross your trailing leg behind your leading leg and take a sideways step with the leading leg to return to the starting position.
Then cross your trailing leg in front, lifting your knee towards your chest, and take another sideways step with your leading leg.
Continue like this to the end of the stretch and come back facing the other way.
carrera-cuesta-arriba: On the way up, lean from your ankles rather than your waist, so that you do not put all the load on your quadriceps and can use your glutes, hamstrings and calves.
Shorten your steps without losing cadence and lift your knees a little higher than on the flat.
Swing your arms a little more than usual, from front to back and without crossing them, with your torso upright and your eyes looking ahead.
desplazamiento-lateral-con-giro: Side shuffle with a half turn
Side-on to the direction of travel, move along with quick sideways steps.
As you approach the middle of the stretch, make a quick half turn and keep shuffling sideways to the end.
hip-thrust-garrafa-banco-parque: Large water bottle hip thrust on a park bench
Rest your upper back and shoulders across the seat of a park bench, with your feet on the ground hip-width apart.
Hold a large water bottle resting on your hips to add resistance.
Slowly lower your tailbone towards the ground without letting go of the large water bottle.
To come up, push the ground away with both feet and squeeze your glutes.
hip-thrust-mochila-banco-parque: Backpack hip thrust on a park bench
Rest your upper back and shoulders across the seat of a park bench, with your feet on the ground hip-width apart.
Place the loaded backpack on your hips and hold it with your hands.
Slowly lower your tailbone towards the ground and, to come up, push the ground away with both feet and squeeze your glutes.
patinador-adelante-arena: On the sand, with your knees bent and your torso upright, take the first step diagonally forward with one foot, without letting your back leg touch the sand.
With your weight in your hips and your knee behind your toes, push off towards your other foot, also diagonally forward.
Swing the arm opposite the leading leg with each push-off and keep skating forward; then go back to the starting point.
rodillas-altas-laterales: Move sideways, lifting your knees, with your knee up and your toes pointing up.
Swing your arms well and keep your abs firm; go to the marked point and come back.
rotacion-cadera-un-pie-biosaludable: Hip rotation with one foot on the rotating footplate
Hold the handle to steady yourself and put one foot on the rotating footplate.
Rotate your hips in a controlled movement.
When you finish your reps, change the direction of rotation.
skipping-lateral-cruzado: Skip sideways, driving the knee of your leading leg straight up.
Cross your other leg in front with your knee high and keep alternating like this to the end of the stretch.
skipping-potencia: Stand with one foot forward, your head up and your knees slightly bent. Take a step and jump powerfully upwards while driving up the knee of your other leg.
As that knee rises, drive the opposite arm forcefully forward and up and take your other arm back.
As you land, repeat straight away leading with the other leg and keep alternating along a stretch. Gain height as you master the movement.
skipping-rodilla-hacia-fuera: Do normal skipping, bringing your knee forward, along a short stretch.
Go back to the start and repeat, this time taking your knee outwards, to the side, opening your hip.
sentadilla-bulgara-garrafa-banco-parque: Bulgarian split squat with a large water bottle on a park bench
With your back to a park bench, step one foot forward and rest the top of the other foot behind you on the seat.
Hold a large water bottle upright in front of your chest with both hands and your elbows tucked into your ribs.
With your back straight, lower your back knee towards the ground.
Before it touches the ground, push through your front foot and press the top of your back foot into the bench to come up.
sentadilla-bulgara-mochila-banco-parque: Bulgarian split squat with a backpack on a park bench
Put on the loaded backpack and, with your back to a park bench, step one foot forward and rest the top of the other foot behind you on the seat.
With your back straight, lower your back knee towards the ground.
Before it touches the ground, push through your front foot and press the top of your back foot into the bench to come up.
caminar-sobre-obstaculos: Place small obstacles about 10 to 15 cm high on the floor, such as shoeboxes or trainers, or mark where they go with sticky tape.
Walk over them without stepping on them; when you reach the end of the course, start again.
Stay next to a table or a handrail so that you can hold on when you need to.
deslizamiento-talon-toalla: Sit on the floor, on a sofa or on the bed with your legs straight and loop a towel around the sole of one foot.
Using the towel to take some of the weight off your foot, slide it towards your hip and let your knee bend as far as it can.
Slide your foot back to the starting position.
elevacion-rodilla-pecho-de-pie: Stand holding on to a table or the back of a chair with one hand to keep your balance.
Very slowly lift one knee and bring it as close to your chest as possible, without bending at the waist.
Lower your leg gradually to the starting position and change legs.
estiramiento-cuadriceps-toalla: Standing quadriceps stretch with a towel
Standing, rest one hand on a wall or a sturdy piece of furniture to keep your balance.
Bend the knee on the other side and loop a towel around your ankle.
Pull on the towel to draw your leg back until you feel the stretch at the front of your thigh and hip; then change legs.
estiramiento-flexor-cadera-silla: Hip flexor stretch on a chair
Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Let one leg slide off the side of the chair and take it back as far as you can, with your knee and toes pointing forward.
extension-rodillas-sentado-cojin: Alternating seated knee extension with a cushion
Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight, or leaning against the back of the chair, and hold a cushion or a soft ball between your knees.
Straighten one leg fully, without letting your ankle rise higher than your knee, while squeezing the cushion moderately.
Lower it and alternate with the other leg.
marcha-sentado: Sit upright on a sturdy chair, without leaning against the back of the chair, and hold on to the sides of the seat.
Lift one leg, with your knee bent, as high as is comfortable and put your foot back down under control.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating.
media-sentadilla-mochila-silla: Half squat with a backpack, holding a chair
Put on a weighted backpack and rest your hands on the back of a sturdy chair, with your feet hip-width apart.
Slowly bend your knees as far as is comfortable, with your knees pointing forward and your back straight.
Come back up gently, squeezing your glutes.
media-sentadilla-silla: Half squat holding the back of a chair
Standing behind a sturdy chair, rest your hands on the back of the chair, with your feet hip-width apart.
Slowly bend your knees as far as is comfortable, with your knees pointing forward, in line with your big toe, and your back straight.
Come back up gently, squeezing your glutes.
sentadilla-a-la-silla: Stand upright in front of a sturdy chair.
Lower yourself slowly, taking your pelvis back as if you were going to sit down, until your glutes lightly touch the chair, without fully sitting down.
Pause briefly and come up slowly, with your hips, knees and toes aligned.
sentadilla-silla-botellas: Squat to a chair with bottles of water
With a full bottle of water in each hand and your arms at your sides, stand in front of a chair with your feet hip-width apart.
Lower yourself, taking your pelvis back until your glutes lightly brush the chair, without actually sitting down.
Push through both feet to stand up again, with your hips, knees and toes aligned.
sentarse-levantarse-silla: Choose a sturdy chair without wheels or arms, such as a dining chair, and sit on the edge with your feet hip-width apart and your body leaning slightly forward.
Stand up slowly using your legs, not your arms, looking straight ahead and not at the floor.
Once standing, sit back down slowly, using your hands only to guide you if possible.
subida-escalon-mochila: Put on a weighted backpack and stand in front of the bottom step of the stairs at home, where you can hold on to the handrail or the wall.
Place your whole foot on the step, step up and bring your other foot up next to it.
Step down with control, without dropping, and alternate the foot you start with.
zancada-atras-deslizando-toalla: Reverse lunge with foot sliding on a towel
Standing on a smooth floor, place a folded towel under one foot.
Slide that foot back until you are in a lunge position.
Return to standing without losing your balance.
zancada-atras-toalla-elevacion-frontal: Reverse lunge on a towel with bottle front raise
Standing with a bottle of water in each hand at your sides, place one foot on a small towel on the floor.
Slide that foot back until your leg is straight, bending your other knee without letting it go past your toes, while you raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Come back by bringing your leg forward and lowering your arms to your sides. When you finish, change feet.
caminar-haciendo-ochos: Place two water bottles on the floor at least a metre apart, or two chairs about two metres apart.
Walk around them, tracing a figure of eight.
Stop and rest without sitting down. To make it harder, close your eyes, but only if someone is beside you.
estiramiento-flexor-cadera-de-pie: Standing hip flexor stretch in a lunge
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, take a long step forward with one foot.
Bend your front knee while pushing the hip on the other side forward, keeping your chest upright, and hold.
Push off your front foot to return to standing.
estiramiento-flexor-cadera-tumbado: Lie on your back with your legs straight on the floor.
Bend one knee, hold the back of your thigh with your hands and bring the knee towards your chest.
You will feel the stretch at the front of the hip and thigh of your straight leg; stay still, without bouncing.
guerrero-uno: Warrior I (held lunge with arms overhead)
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, take a long step forward with your right foot as you raise your arms, with your palms facing each other.
Keep your right foot pointing forward and turn your left foot out 45 to 60 degrees; bend your right knee without letting it go past your toes, with your back leg straight and its heel on the floor.
Lower your hips and square your torso to the front as you stretch your arms upwards; hold for 20 to 30 seconds and change sides.
marcha-en-el-sitio: Standing in one place, without moving forward, raise your knees alternately.
Keep to a pace you can sustain without becoming exhausted.
saltador-alto: Stand with your torso leaning slightly forward and your palms facing in.
Bring your arms forward to horizontal while you do a small vertical jump, and land softly on the balls of your feet.
Then swing your arms forcefully forward and over your head and jump up powerfully; land softly on the balls of your feet again.
sentadilla-alcance-sobre-puntas: Squat with floor reach and rise onto tiptoe
Stand with your legs apart and your hands on your waist.
Squat down with your heels on the floor and your back straight until your palms reach towards the floor, looking straight ahead.
Come up quickly, stretching your arms above your head, and rise onto tiptoe, without your feet leaving the floor; return to the squat and then to the starting position.
sentadilla-botellas: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a bottle of water in each hand.
Bend your knees and lower yourself as if you were going to sit on a chair, with your knees in line with your toes.
Go as low as you can without losing good posture and push through your feet to come back up.
sentadilla-latas-hombros: Squat with tins on the shoulders
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, rest a tin or a bottle in each hand on the front of your shoulders.
Keeping them in place, bend your knees and lower yourself as if you were going to sit on a chair, with your knees in line with your toes.
Go as low as you can without losing good posture and push through your feet to come back up.
sentadilla-mochila-espalda: Squat with a backpack on the back
Put on a backpack with only as much weight as you can lift comfortably.
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, bend your knees and lower yourself as if you were going to sit on a chair, with your knees in line with your toes.
Go as low as you can without losing good posture and push through your feet to come back up.
sentadilla-mochila-pecho: Squat with a backpack hugged to the chest
Fill a backpack or a sports bag with books, tins or bottles of water and hold it in front of your chest.
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, take your hips back and down into a squat, keeping the backpack against your chest the whole time.
Keep your torso upright, without leaning forward, and push through your feet to come back up.
sentadilla-y-flexion-de-tronco: Stand with your legs apart and your hands on your waist.
Squat down, leaning your torso slightly forward, with your head up and your arms stretched out in front, parallel to the floor, and come back up.
Then, with your knees slightly bent, bend forward from the waist with your back straight and your head in line, and lower your hands towards the floor.
Stop when you feel the stretch at the back of your thighs, return to the starting position and alternate the two parts.
subir-bajar-escaleras: Go up and down a flight of stairs, using the handrail at first.
Start with a few steps and gradually increase the number of steps.
toques-talon-al-frente: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your eyes fixed on a point in front of you.
Move one foot forward with your knee straight and touch the floor with your heel; bring the leg back and repeat with the other.
To make it harder, raise both straight arms in front of you to about 45 degrees each time you move your foot forward.
estiramiento-cadera-rodillas-giro: Kneeling hip stretch with torso rotation
Kneel with one foot forward and flat on the floor and the knee of your other leg on a cushion.
With your arms above your head, rotate your torso towards the side of your front leg, keeping your back straight and without arching your lower back.
Hold for 20 seconds and change legs.
sentadilla-botellas-elevacion-brazos: Squat with bottles and arm raise
Standing with a bottle of water in each hand at your sides, raise your arms above your head.
Lower your arms while you bend your knees, taking your hips back and your weight onto your heels, until your hands are roughly over your knees, without touching them.
Come back up by straightening your knees and raising your arms again; your knees should not go past your toes.
sentadilla-en-y: Squat with arms in a Y
Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders, your arms stretched above your head in a Y shape and your shoulders drawn back.
Lower yourself as far as you can without rounding your back, with your shoulders back, your arms in a Y and your heels on the floor.
Come up to the starting position and repeat.
sentadilla-goblet-garrafa: Goblet squat with a large water bottle
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a full large water bottle in front of your chest.
With your elbows close to your ribs and your back straight, squat down, keeping the bottle in place, until your hips are below your knees.
Push the floor away with both feet to come back up.
sentadilla-press-botellas: Squat to shoulder press with bottles
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, raise a tin or a full bottle in each hand to your shoulders, with your elbows out to the sides at a right angle.
Push your hips back and bend your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor; pause briefly at the bottom.
Come up slowly and, as you stand up, straighten your arms overhead, pushing the weights towards the ceiling.
Lower the weights until your elbows are at a right angle again.
estiramiento-cadera-zancada-giro: Lunge hip stretch with torso rotation
Take a long step forward, without letting your knee go past your toes, and raise your straight arms above your head.
At the end of the lunge, rotate your torso towards the side of your front leg.
Hold for 20 seconds and change legs.
sentadilla-curl-alterno-botellas: Stand with your legs shoulder-width apart and hold a bottle of water in each hand with your elbows tucked into your body.
Squat down, taking your glutes towards your heels, with your back straight.
On each squat, bring one bottle up towards your shoulder, alternating arms, with your elbows close to your body and without raising your shoulders.
zancada-giro-botella: Lunge with torso twist holding a bottle
Standing on a non-slip floor, hold a half-litre bottle of water, more or less full, or a cushion in front of your chest with both hands.
Lunge forward, bending your knee without letting it go past your toes, and turn your torso towards the side of your front leg.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your back straight; return to the starting position and, when you finish, change legs.
caminar-estirando-cuadriceps: As you walk, hold the ankle of one leg with one hand and draw it back, without arching your back.
Let go, take a step and repeat with the other leg, alternating over a short distance.
carrera-continua-buena-tecnica: Run with your head up and in line with your shoulders, looking slightly down and ahead, with your jaw relaxed.
Keep your arms bent at about 90 degrees, without crossing them in front of your chest, and your hands relaxed.
Lean slightly forward without hunching, with your chest high and your shoulders level.
Do not overstride: land with your foot below your hips or slightly in front of them, between the arch and the ball of your foot.
impulso-una-pierna-escalon: Facing a sturdy step, put your right foot on it and leave your left on the floor, with your torso leaning slightly forward from the hips and your eyes on the floor ahead of you.
Jump up by pushing hard through the foot on the step while driving off with the other and swinging your arms up and forward; in the air, lift your left leg.
Land softly and quietly on your midfoot, sending your hips back and down to absorb the landing, without locking your knees.
Do the same number of reps with each leg.
pedaleo-brazos-piernas-biosaludable: Arm and leg cycling on the outdoor gym machine
Get on as you would a bicycle, with your feet on the foot pedals and your hands on the hand pedals.
Move the foot pedals and the hand pedals at the same time.
pedaleo-piernas-biosaludable: Seated pedalling on the outdoor gym bike
Sit properly, with your back against the backrest, and put your feet on the pedals.
Pedal forward with a smooth, circular movement of your legs.
Go slowly, at a comfortable pace and without losing control of the movement.
progresivos: Start running at an easy pace at the beginning of a short stretch.
Gradually increase your speed along the stretch, stopping short of a sprint.
saltos-manos-viga-biosaludable: Jumps with hands on the beam
Standing next to the beam, put both hands on it to take some of your weight on them.
Bend your knees and jump to the other side of the beam in a single movement.
sentadilla-agarrado-barra-biosaludable: Squat holding the bar of the machine
Standing upright facing the bar, with your feet hip-width apart, hold on to it so that you do not lose your balance.
Tighten your abs and lower yourself as if sitting on an invisible chair, taking your hips back rather than down.
Straighten your legs to come back up, with your back straight and your shoulders back.
sentadilla-banco-parque-mochila: Squat to a park bench with a backpack
Put on the loaded backpack and stand in front of a park bench, with your back to it and your feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
With your abs firm and your chest high, push your hips back and lower yourself with your back straight until you lightly touch the bench.
Push the ground away with your feet and drive your hips forward to stand up again.
subida-banco-parque-garrafas: Step-up onto a park bench with large water bottles
Standing facing a sturdy park bench, with your feet parallel and hip-width apart, hold a large water bottle in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Slowly place one foot on the seat, with your whole foot firmly on it, and step up with your torso upright.
To step down, put your weight on your front leg, take the other leg back down to the ground and then lower the first one.
zancada-atras-barras-biosaludable: Reverse lunge holding the high parallel bars
Hold the high parallel bars with both hands.
Take one leg back and lower your knee towards the ground.
Complete your reps and change sides.
aceleraciones-cortas: Short accelerations from a standing start
From a standing start, set off by driving yourself forward and pushing the ground back behind you, with decisive first steps.
Keep pushing without straightening up all at once: let your body rise gradually as you pick up speed, over a short distance.
Recover fully between accelerations so that each one is clean.
carrera-cuesta-abajo: On the way down, keep your torso upright with your chest over your knees, without leaning back.
Take short, quick steps and land softly on your midfoot, with your knees slightly bent, as if they were shock absorbers.
Keep your abs engaged and squeeze your shoulder blades together to stay stable at speed.
carrera-de-espaldas: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and run on the spot with quick steps.
Let yourself lean slightly back and run backwards for a short distance, reaching back with your foot on each step in a full running action.
Without stopping, turn round and keep running forward for a short distance.
carrera-por-sendero: On uneven ground, shorten your stride to keep your centre of gravity over your midfoot.
Instead of looking at your feet, look at the path a few metres ahead so that you can anticipate stones and roots.
On very steep climbs, walk if it is more efficient for you; on descents, keep your torso upright and your steps short and quick.
fartlek: During a run at your normal pace, pick a point in the distance and run as hard as you can until you reach it.
Walk until your heart rate and breathing settle, then go back to your normal running pace; repeat these changes of pace throughout your run.
press-piernas-biosaludable-una-pierna: Single-leg press on the outdoor gym machine
Sit with your back against the backrest and put just one foot firmly on the footplate.
Push with that foot until your leg is straight and bring it back in, always keeping the movement controlled.
Do not lock your knee as you straighten it.
Do your reps with one leg and then with the other.
salida-por-caida: Standing upright, lean forward with your body straight, without bending at the waist, until you are almost falling.
At that moment, push off hard and focus on making your first steps very powerful.
saltos-diagonales-adelante-atras: Alternating diagonal jumps forward and back
Standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, jump forward and to the left onto your left leg, bringing your right arm forward and your left arm back.
Then jump forward and to the right onto your right leg, with your arms the other way round, and repeat these two jumps.
Go back with the same diagonal jumps, first to the left and then to the right, and finish in the starting position.
saltos-pies-juntos-viga-biosaludable: Two-footed jumps over the low beam
Stand next to the beam with your feet together.
Crouch slightly forward, bend your knees and jump over the beam in a single movement.
sentadilla-una-pierna-asas-biosaludable: Single-leg squat holding the machine handles
Hold the handles and shift your weight onto the heel of one foot.
Stretch your other leg out in front of your body and squat down.
Push up through your heel, keeping your front leg straight throughout.
sprint-corto: Run as fast as you can over a short stretch.
Accelerate along the whole stretch, without trying to gain everything in the first few metres.
Rest fully before repeating: much longer than the sprint itself lasts.
sprint-ida-vuelta-toque-suelo: Mark a start line and, further ahead, a turning point. Stand with one foot forward, your head up, your knees slightly bent and the opposite arm in front.
Run fast to the turning point, turn on one foot and, crouching down, touch the ground with the hand on that same side.
Run quickly back to the start, turn the other way, touching the ground with your other hand, and run again to the turning point, accelerating flat out to the finish.
subida-banco-elevacion-rodilla: Step-up onto a bench or step with knee raise
Stand facing a sturdy bench or a step, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step up with your right leg and stand on top with both feet.
Raise your left knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor, put it back down and step down.
Repeat, starting with the other leg.
subida-banco-parque-mochila: Step-up onto a park bench with a backpack
Put on the loaded backpack and stand facing a sturdy park bench, with your feet parallel and hip-width apart.
Slowly place one foot on the seat, with your whole foot firmly on it, and step up with your torso upright.
To step down, put your weight on your front leg, take the other leg back down to the ground and then lower the first one.
subir-escaleras-de-dos-en-dos: Going up stairs two at a time
Warm up first by jogging on the spot or walking up a flight of stairs.
When walking up feels easy, bound up the stairs, taking the steps two at a time.
Only do this if you are experienced at exercising and move confidently on stairs.
trote-y-arrancada: Jog gently towards the end of the stretch.
On a signal, for example a whistle, switch suddenly into a full-speed sprint.
carrera-agachado: Get into a high plank with one foot forward under your chest and your knee between your arms, and do one full mountain climber before you set off.
Run forward in a crouch for a stretch, moving your arms very little, as if you were carrying an object in your hands.

At the end, turn, touch the ground with one hand while staying crouched and come back crouched. Back at the start, turn, touching the ground with your other hand, and accelerate upright at full speed all the way to the end.
sprint-escaleras: After warming up, find an outdoor flight of stairs, such as the steps of a stadium stand, and run up one flight as fast as you can.
Return to the starting point and recover by walking before going up again; over time you can run up more than one flight in a row.
Only for experienced people who move confidently on stairs.
sprint-largo: Run a long sprint: reach a high speed and try to maintain it.
Keep your stride rhythm and do not try to increase your step rate when you feel yourself losing power.
Watch for signs of fatigue: your step rate drops, your foot spends more time on the ground and you lose momentum.
arrastre-toalla-pie-sentado: Seated towel drag with the foot
Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight, your knees bent at a right angle and a towel under one foot.
Straighten your leg, dragging the towel along the floor while pressing it down firmly with the sole of your foot, and return to the starting position.
As a variation, do it with both legs together.
estiramiento-isquios-dos-sillas: Sideways hamstring stretch on two chairs
Sit sideways across two chairs placed side by side and, with your back straight, stretch one leg out along them with your toes pointing up and your other foot on the floor.
If you already feel the stretch, hold for 10 to 30 seconds.
If you do not, lean forward from your hips, not your waist, until you feel it in the straight leg, and hold for 10 to 30 seconds.
estiramiento-isquios-gemelos-silla: Hamstring and calf stretch on a chair
Slowly lean forward from your hips, with your legs straight but without locking your knees, and rest your hands on the seat with your elbows slightly bent.
Keep your back flat while you feel the stretch in the back of your thigh and lower leg.
estiramiento-isquios-sentado-toalla: Seated hamstring stretch with a towel
Sit on the floor, straighten one leg and place the sole of your other foot against the upper inner thigh of the straight leg.
Loop a towel around the sole of the foot of your straight leg and hold both ends.
Lean forward slightly, pulling on the towel, until you feel a gentle stretch, and hold for about 6 seconds.
Relax and repeat with the other leg.
curl-femoral-con-curl-brazos: Standing hamstring curl with arm curl
Stand with your hands at your sides.
Bring one heel towards your glute as you bend your arms at the elbows.
Lower your leg and arms at the same time and repeat with the other leg.
estiramiento-isquios-de-pie-talon: Standing hamstring stretch with the heel forward
Standing upright with your arms at your sides, put one straight leg forward with your heel on the floor and your toes pointing at the ceiling.
Rest your hands on the tops of your thighs and lean forward from your hips, with your back neutral.
You should not feel any pressure behind your knee or in your back.
estiramiento-isquios-talon-pared: Hamstring stretch with the heel on the wall
Lie on your back at the outside corner of a wall, with your left leg alongside the wall.
Raise your left leg and rest your heel on the wall, with your knee slightly bent.
Gently straighten your leg until you feel the stretch at the back of your thigh, hold for about 30 seconds and change legs.
peso-muerto-bolsa: Deadlift with a bag between the feet
Standing with your feet hip-width apart, place a bag of tins or other household items on the floor between your feet and slightly in front.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward to grip the bag with both hands.
Lift it by straightening your hips, with your abs firm so that you do not arch your lower back, and lower it along the same path, straight down between your legs.
buenos-dias-mochila: Put the loaded backpack on your back, like a weighted vest, and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.

Shift your weight onto your heels and push your hips back with your back straight, without arching it, and lean your torso forward until it is halfway between upright and the floor, with your knees only slightly bent.
Slowly return to standing, squeezing your glutes and driving your hips forward and up.
estiramiento-isquios-desde-cuclillas: Squat down, with your upper body against your thighs and your palms flat on the floor on either side of your feet.
From there, straighten your knees until you feel the tension at the backs of your legs.
patada-frontal-toque-alterno: Front kick with opposite hand touch
Stand with your legs apart and your hands on your waist.
Raise your left leg in front of you until it is parallel to the floor while you bend forward from the waist and bring your right hand towards your left foot; your left arm goes back.
Return to the starting position and repeat with your right leg and left hand.
peso-muerto-rumano-garrafas: Romanian deadlift with large water bottles
Standing, hold a full large water bottle in each hand, resting against the front of your thighs.
With your knees slightly bent and your back straight, push your hips back as you lower the bottles towards the floor.
Stop when you feel tension at the back of your legs.
To come up, push the floor away with your heels and draw your knees back, keeping the bottles very close to your body.
peso-muerto-rumano-mochila: Fill a backpack with books, tins or bottles and hold it with both hands, resting against the front of your thighs.
With your knees slightly bent and your back straight, push your hips back as you lower the backpack towards the floor.
Stop when you feel tension at the back of your legs.
To come up, push the floor away with your heels and draw your knees back, keeping the backpack very close to your body.
perro-boca-abajo-pierna-elevada: Downward dog with one leg raised
From the downward dog pose, lift one leg and stretch it up towards the ceiling.
For a deeper stretch, bend that leg back and over your body, so that your knee points outwards.
Hold for as long as is comfortable and repeat with the other leg.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-garrafa: Single-leg deadlift with a large water bottle
Stand on one leg, with your knee slightly bent and your back straight, and hold a full large water bottle in the opposite hand.
Lean forward from your hip and, at the same time, stretch your free leg out behind you, with your toes pointed, for balance.
With your arm straight, let the bottle drop vertically in front of your standing leg.
Push the floor away with your standing foot, lower your other leg as you come up and pause in balance before the next one.
peso-muerto-una-pierna-remo-botellas: Single-leg deadlift and row with bottles
Standing with a tin or a full bottle in each hand, lean forward, shifting your weight onto one leg, with that knee slightly bent, and raise your other leg behind you.
From there, bend your elbows until your hands reach your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower your straight arms towards the floor and put your raised leg back down in the starting position.
estiramiento-isquios-barra-biosaludable: Hamstring stretch with the heel on the bar
Only do this stretch after warming up or at the end of your workout, never with cold muscles.
Rest the heel of one foot on one of the bars, at whatever height suits you, with the knee of that leg straight.
Lean forward to stretch the back of your thigh and hold for 15 to 30 seconds.
patada-pierna-recta-caminando: As you walk, swing one straight leg forward, with your toes pointing up.
Bring your opposite hand towards the toes of that foot.
Take a few steps and repeat with the other leg.
cangrejo-arena: Sit on the sand facing the starting point, with your knees bent and your hands on the ground below your shoulders.
Lift your hips off the ground as high as you can.
Move along by pulling with the backs of your thighs and pushing with your arms, taking short, quick steps so as not to strain your wrists, to the end of the course and back.
marcha-b: Walk tall, lifting your knee above your waist.
From the top, extend your leg forward and bring it down with a clawing action to place your foot below your hip; repeat with the other leg.
carrera-lanzada: Take a run-up, building your speed so that you go into a short section already at your target speed; run that section at top speed.
Over that section, keep your hips high, land with your foot directly below your body and stay relaxed.
Take a long recovery before repeating.
skipping-b: Skip with your knee high and your toes pointing up.
From the top, extend your leg slightly forward and bring it down with a clawing action to land your foot under your hip, not in front of it; alternate legs.
circulos-tobillos-sentado: Sit comfortably on a sofa or a chair with your heels resting on the floor in front of you.
Slowly rotate both ankles, taking your toes out to the sides, down towards the floor, towards each other and up towards the ceiling.
deslizamiento-lateral-toalla-pie: Sideways towel slide with the foot
Sitting down, place a towel folded in half lengthways on the floor and rest one foot on it.
Hold the heel in place with your other foot so that the leg does not move.
Slide the towel from side to side with firm movements of your foot; the movement comes only from your foot and ankle.
Spread the towel out flat again.
elevacion-talones-sentado-botellas-silla: Seated bottle calf raise on a chair
Sit upright on a chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a water bottle in each hand resting on your thighs.
Raise both heels by pushing down through your toes, only as far as is comfortable.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
elevacion-talones-sentado-mochila-silla: Seated calf raise with a backpack on the thighs
Sit upright on a chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and a weighted backpack on your thighs.
Raise both heels by pushing down through your toes, only as far as is comfortable.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
estiramiento-gemelo-toalla-enrollada: Calf stretch on a rolled towel
Standing, take one foot back with the whole sole flat on the floor until you feel tension in your calf.
For a deeper stretch, raise the toes of your back foot by standing on a rolled-up hand towel.
Hold for 30 seconds and change legs.
recoger-toalla-dedos-pie: Sit with your feet flat on the floor and a towel spread out under the front of one foot.
Scrunch the towel with your toes and drag it towards you, pulling with the tips of your toes.
Lift and straighten your toes, then scrunch the towel again to keep pulling it closer.
caminar-de-puntillas: Stand near a stable surface, such as a table or a chair, in case you need to put a hand on it.
caminar-sobre-talones: Stand near a stable surface, such as a table or a chair, in case you need to put a hand on it.
Walk forward, stepping only on your heels.
elevacion-talones-mochila: Put the loaded backpack on your back and set your feet hip-width apart, flat on the floor with your toes pointing forward.
With your chest high and your knees slightly bent, push through the balls of your feet and raise your heels.
Pause at the top and lower your heels slowly to the floor.
equilibrio-pies-juntos-ojos-cerrados: Stand next to a wall with your feet together and your arms crossed.
Close your eyes and keep your balance for 20 to 30 seconds.
equilibrio-puntillas-talones: Stand next to a table or a handrail in case you need to hold on.
Rise onto your tiptoes, with your weight on your toes only, and hold while you count to 10.
Then stand on your heels only and hold again; alternate between the two positions.
marcha-talon-punta: Standing upright, hold your arms out to the sides at shoulder height and fix your eyes on a point in front of you.
Take a step, placing your heel just in front of the toes of your other foot, so that they touch or almost touch.
Repeat with the other foot, always looking straight ahead, and keep moving forward in a straight line.
If you need to, lightly touch a wall with your fingers so that you do not lose your balance.
medio-salto-tijera: Jump and land with your feet shoulder-width apart and pointing forward, while you raise your straight arms out to the sides, palms down, no higher than horizontal.
Jump again to return to attention and repeat, controlling each landing.
movilidad-tobillo-semi-rodillas: Kneel on one knee with your other foot flat on the floor in front of you.
Bring your torso, hips and front knee forward over your front foot as far as you can.
Return to the starting position, repeat and change legs.
posicion-tandem: Standing, place one foot directly in front of the other, so that only the heel of your front foot and the toes of your back foot touch.
Hold the position and, if you can, close your eyes.
saltador-alto-sin-salto: Stand leaning slightly forward, with your knees slightly bent and your palms facing in.
Bring your arms forward to horizontal while you lift your heels slightly, without jumping.
Then swing your arms as high as possible over your head and return to the starting position, lowering your heels.
elevacion-talones-botellas: Stand without support, holding a water bottle in each hand with your arms at your sides.
Raise both heels off the floor as far as is comfortable, slowly and under control, and lower them slowly.
salto-con-giro-alterno: Stand with your legs apart and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Jump, turning your hips and legs to the left, and land with your feet staggered, left foot in front.
Return to the starting position and repeat, turning to the right, with your right foot in front.
saltos-cruzando-pies: Jump, crossing your left foot in front of your right, and land with your feet crossed.
Immediately jump again, this time crossing your right foot in front of your left, and keep alternating.
saltos-pata-coja-en-el-sitio: Standing with your legs apart, lift one leg by bending your knee, with your foot under your hip.
Hop on the spot on your other leg.
apoyo-una-pierna-ojos-cerrados: Single-leg stand with arms crossed and eyes closed
Stand next to a wall in case you lose your balance.
Stand on one leg only, cross your arms over your chest and close your eyes.
Keep your balance for as long as you can, working up to 60 seconds per leg, then change legs.
saltitos-alternos-avanzando: Stand on one foot with your other leg tucked up under your hip.
Hop from one foot to the other on the spot and, without stopping, move forward hopping like this for a short stretch, without bending at the waist.
When you finish, keep running for a short stretch.
skipping-brazos-cruzados: Skipping with arms crossing in front
Skip forward while swinging your arms horizontally, crossing them in front of your chest.
Keep going like this to the marked point and come back.
elevacion-talon-una-pierna-escalon-garra: Single-leg calf raise on a step with a large water bottle
Find a step in the street next to a wall and place only the ball of one foot on the edge, with your heel in the air.
Bend your other knee to lift that foot, place the fingertips of one hand on the wall for balance and hold a large water bottle in the other.
Slowly raise your heel with your knee straight, hold for a moment at the top and lower it slowly.
equilibrio-disco-movil-dedos-biosaludabl: Balance on the wobble disc with fingertip support
Stand up tall and place one foot on the wobble disc.
Touch the handles with your fingertips only; if you can, do it without using your hands.
Hold for 1 to 2 minutes on each foot, wobbling a little to test your balance, but always feeling safe.
estiramiento-gemelo-escalon: Calf stretch with the heel off a step
Find a step next to a wall and place your whole right foot on it; put your left foot on the back edge of the step, resting only on the ball of the foot, with the heel in the air.
Rest your fingertips on the wall to keep your balance.
Slowly lower your back heel towards the floor while bending your front knee and hold for 15 to 30 seconds; change sides.
saltos-pogo-avanzando: With both feet together, move forward with quick little jumps, driving with your ankles, as when skipping with a rope.
Bend your knees only slightly and spend very little time on the ground: do not turn it into mini squats.
skipping-hacia-atras: Move backwards while skipping, with quick steps, bringing your foot over the opposite knee.
As a variation, do it opening your hip on each step.
equilibrio-disco-movil-un-pie-biosaludab: Single-leg balance on the wobble disc
Stand up tall on the wobble disc.
Lift one knee so that you are standing on one foot only.
Try to wobble a little to test your balance, but do not overdo it: you should feel safe.
Hold for 1 to 2 minutes and change feet.
sentadilla-bulgara-silla: Bulgarian split squat with the back foot on a chair
Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair and put one foot forward. Stand up without moving it: this sets the distance.
Rest your other foot on the chair behind you. With your chest up and your stomach muscles tight, slowly lower your back knee towards the floor, keeping your front knee in line over your foot.
Push through your front heel to come back up. Do all the repetitions on one leg before changing sides.
If your balance or flexibility is still limited, use a lower chair.
